None

### PTOAS build level (if relevant)

```
  %6 = pto.fusion_region {

    %10 = pto.bind_tile %9, %c32, %c128 {config = #pto.tile_buf_config<blayout=#pto.blayout<row_major>, slayout=#pto.slayout<none_box>, s_fractal_size=512, pad=#pto.pad_value<null>, compact=#pto.compact_mode<null>>} : memref<32x128xf32, strided<[128, 1]>, #pto.address_space<vec>> -> memref<32x128xf32, strided<[128, 1], offset: ?>, #pto.address_space<vec>>

    pto.wait_flag[<PIPE_MTE2>, <PIPE_V>, <EVENT_ID1>]

### Reproduction (minimal)

```markdown
// Copyright (c) 2026 Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.
// This program is free software, you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms and conditions of
// CANN Open Software License Agreement Version 2.0 (the "License").

// INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO NON-INFRINGEMENT, MERCHANTABILITY, OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
// See LICENSE in the root of the software repository for the full text of the License.

// Minimal elementwise tadd/tsub case to probe VfSim unroll on a 32x128 tile
// (col=128 -> two 64-lane inner iterations, same col-trip-2 geometry as the
// GeLU 32x128 case, so VfSim is expected to inject col_unroll_factor = 2 and
// the unroll pass should fully unroll the inner col scf.for).
//

module attributes {pto.target_arch = "a5", pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<vector>} {
  func.func @vfsim_unroll_tadd_tsub_32x128(
      %x_ptr: !pto.ptr<f32>, %y_ptr: !pto.ptr<f32>,
      %z_ptr: !pto.ptr<f32>, %out_ptr: !pto.ptr<f32>) attributes {pto.kernel} {
    %c0 = arith.constant 0 : index
    %c1 = arith.constant 1 : index
    %c32 = arith.constant 32 : index
    %c128 = arith.constant 128 : index
    %c4096 = arith.constant 4096 : index

    %x_view = pto.make_tensor_view %x_ptr,
      shape = [%c1, %c1, %c1, %c32, %c128],
      strides = [%c4096, %c4096, %c4096, %c128, %c1]
      : !pto.tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>
    %y_view = pto.make_tensor_view %y_ptr,
      shape = [%c1, %c1, %c1, %c32, %c128],
      strides = [%c4096, %c4096, %c4096, %c128, %c1]
      : !pto.tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>
    %z_view = pto.make_tensor_view %z_ptr,
      shape = [%c1, %c1, %c1, %c32, %c128],
      strides = [%c4096, %c4096, %c4096, %c128, %c1]
      : !pto.tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>
    %out_view = pto.make_tensor_view %out_ptr,
      shape = [%c1, %c1, %c1, %c32, %c128],
      strides = [%c4096, %c4096, %c4096, %c128, %c1]
      : !pto.tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>

    %x_part = pto.partition_view %x_view,
      offsets = [%c0, %c0, %c0, %c0, %c0],
      sizes = [%c1, %c1, %c1, %c32, %c128]
      : !pto.tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>
    %y_part = pto.partition_view %y_view,
      offsets = [%c0, %c0, %c0, %c0, %c0],
      sizes = [%c1, %c1, %c1, %c32, %c128]
      : !pto.tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>
    %z_part = pto.partition_view %z_view,
      offsets = [%c0, %c0, %c0, %c0, %c0],
      sizes = [%c1, %c1, %c1, %c32, %c128]
      : !pto.tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>
    %out_part = pto.partition_view %out_view,
      offsets = [%c0, %c0, %c0, %c0, %c0],
      sizes = [%c1, %c1, %c1, %c32, %c128]
      : !pto.tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>

    %vx = pto.alloc_tile : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>
    %vy = pto.alloc_tile : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>
    %vz = pto.alloc_tile : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>
    %vadd = pto.alloc_tile : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>
    %vout = pto.alloc_tile : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>

    pto.tload ins(%x_part : !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>)
              outs(%vx : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>)
    pto.tload ins(%y_part : !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>)
              outs(%vy : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>)
    pto.tload ins(%z_part : !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>)
              outs(%vz : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>)

    pto.tadd ins(%vx, %vy : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>, !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>)
             outs(%vadd : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>)
    pto.tsub ins(%vadd, %vz : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>, !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>)
             outs(%vout : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>)

    pto.tstore ins(%vout : !pto.tile_buf<vec, 32x128xf32>)
               outs(%out_part : !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x1x1x32x128xf32>)
    return
  }
}
```

### Expected behavior

`pto-fusion-region-gen` 已把 `tadd`/`tsub` 放进同一个 `pto.fusion_region`（融合组）。
`pto-insert-sync` 应当**识别 fusion_region 的语义边界**：对融合组内部的 op 间，跨管线同步
应当要么插在 region 边界（外提），要么复用同一 event，不应在 region 内部、`tadd` 与 `tsub`
之间插入 `wait_flag`，从而切开融合组。

即 fusion_region 内部应保持：

```mlir
  %6 = pto.fusion_region {
    pto.tadd ins(%1, %3:...) outs(%8:...)
    pto.tsub ins(%8, %5:...) outs(%10:...)
  }
```

### Actual behavior / error logs

```text
`pto-insert-sync` 在 fusion_region 内部、`tadd` 与 `tsub` 之间插入了 `wait_flag`，
把融合组切开。`--mlir-print-ir-after=pto-insert-sync` 输出：


  %6 = pto.fusion_region {
    pto.wait_flag[<PIPE_MTE2>, <PIPE_V>, <EVENT_ID0>]   // tadd 前
    pto.tadd ins(%1, %3:...) outs(%8:...) {candidates = ...}
    pto.wait_flag[<PIPE_MTE2>, <PIPE_V>, <EVENT_ID1>]   // tadd 与 tsub 之间 ← 问题点
    pto.tsub ins(%8, %5:...) outs(%10:...) {candidates = ...}
  }
```

## #984 [Bug] VPTO CSE 跨 barrier 合并相同 vdup，导致 vecscope inference 报 vreg external users

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/984
- Created: 2026-07-23T08:14:41Z
- Updated: 2026-08-04T07:15:42Z
- Closed: 2026-08-04T07:15:42Z

### Body

### Component

PTO Dialect / ODS (include/PTO/IR)

### Description

使用 PTOAS 编译 TileLang 生成的 SwiGLU forward PTO IR 时，PTOInferVPTOVecScope 阶段失败：
```
error: 'pto.vdup' op cannot infer resultless pto.vecscope because
VPTO vector-scope data cannot have external users;
escaping value type is '!pto.vreg<64xf32>'

Error: VPTO emission pipeline failed.
```
原因是：
vecscope inference 之前执行的 CSE，会把 barrier 两侧两个相同的 pto.vdup 合并为同一个 SSA value，导致 !pto.vreg 跨越 vecscope boundary 使用。

### Reproduction (minimal)

```markdown
module attributes {pto.target_arch = "a5"} {
  module attributes {pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<vector>} {
    func.func @cse_same_across_barrier() {
      %c0 = arith.constant 0 : index
      %c64 = arith.constant 64 : index
      %c0_i64 = arith.constant 0 : i64
      %cst = arith.constant 0.0 : f32

      %ub = pto.castptr %c0_i64 : i64 -> !pto.ptr<f32, ub>

      %mask0 = pto.pset_b32 "PAT_ALL" : !pto.mask<b32>
      %vec0 = pto.vdup %cst, %mask0
        : f32, !pto.mask<b32> -> !pto.vreg<64xf32>

      pto.vsts %vec0, %ub[%c0], %mask0
        : !pto.vreg<64xf32>,
          !pto.ptr<f32, ub>,
          !pto.mask<b32>

      pto.barrier #pto.pipe<PIPE_ALL>

      %mask1 = pto.pset_b32 "PAT_ALL" : !pto.mask<b32>
      %vec1 = pto.vdup %cst, %mask1
        : f32, !pto.mask<b32> -> !pto.vreg<64xf32>

      pto.vsts %vec1, %ub[%c64], %mask1
        : !pto.vreg<64xf32>,
          !pto.ptr<f32, ub>,
          !pto.mask<b32>

      return
    }
  }
}
```

### Expected behavior

合法的两个独立 vdup 不应因为 CSE 被转换成跨 vecscope boundary 使用的单个 !pto.vreg。
最小复现应成功生成两个独立 vecscope，例如：
```
pto.vecscope {
  %mask0 = pto.pset_b32 "PAT_ALL"
  %vec0 = pto.vdup %cst, %mask0
  pto.vsts %vec0, ...
}

pto.barrier <PIPE_ALL>

pto.vecscope {
  %mask1 = pto.pset_b32 "PAT_ALL"
  %vec1 = pto.vdup %cst, %mask1
  pto.vsts %vec1, ...
}
```

### Actual behavior / error logs

```text
error: 'pto.vdup' op cannot infer resultless pto.vecscope because
VPTO vector-scope data cannot have external users;
escaping value type is '!pto.vreg<64xf32>'

Error: VPTO emission pipeline failed.
```

## #985 [Feature] DSL facade 跨核同步接口能力不完整

- State: open
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/985
- Created: 2026-07-23T09:15:24Z
- Updated: 2026-08-11T12:24:10Z
- Closed: 

### Body

### Summary

# 背景

当前客户项目 向用户暴露了 `XXX_cross_core_set_flag(mode_id, pipe, flag_id)` 和 `XXX_cross_core_wait_flag(mode_id, pipe, flag_id)` 两个跨核同步原语，三个参数的含义如下：

| 参数 | 类型 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `mode_id` | int | 同步模式，取值 0/1/2/4，控制信号传播范围（跨 block 全核同步 / AIV 间同步 / CV 广播汇聚 / CV 逐子核 1:1） |
| `pipe` | str | 流水线类型，如 PIPE_FIX / PIPE_MTE3 / PIPE_V / PIPE_M 等，指定信号发射或等待的流水线 |
| `flag_id` | int 或 PrimExpr | 信号量编号，A5 平台范围 0-31（0-15 对应 AIV0，16-31 对应 AIV1） |

在 AscendC codegen 中，这三个参数直接透传为 `CrossCoreSetFlag<mode_id, pipe>(flag_id)` / `CrossCoreWaitFlag<mode_id, pipe>(flag_id)`，功能完整。
https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/900/API/ascendcopapi/atlasascendc_api_07_0273.html 

现在我们要实现 PTO codegen，需要将 这两个接口映射到 PTO DSL 的等价接口。但当前 PTO DSL facade 暴露的跨核同步接口在能力上有缺失，无法完整覆盖这两个接口的全部功能。

## 接口的完整功能规格

### mode_id 的四种模式

| mode_id | 含义 | 典型场景 |
|---------|------|---------|
| 0 | 跨 block 同类型核同步（所有 AIC↔AIC 或所有 AIV↔AIV） | 多个 block 分担计算，需要所有同类型核到达屏障 |
| 1 | block 内 AIV 子核间同步（AIV0 ↔ AIV1） | 两个 AIV 子核协作处理数据，需要互相通知 |
| 2 | block 内 AIC↔AIV 同步，广播+汇聚（一次 set 到达两个 AIV，一次 wait 等到两个 AIV 都完成） | AIC 算完 GEMM 一次性通知两个 AIV 来搬数据 |
| 4 | block 内 AIC↔AIV 同步，1:1 逐子核（AIV0 和 AIV1 可单独触发） | AIC 分别通知 AIV0 和 AIV1，用不同 flag_id 区分目标子核 |

### pipe 参数

pipe 指定信号在哪条流水线上发射（set 端）或阻塞（wait 端）。pipe 的选择必须与实际数据流经过的流水线匹配，选错会导致数据竞争。

pipe 的合法取值取决于具体场景，不应被固定为某个值。不同 mode_id 和不同操作侧（Cube/Vector）需要的 pipe 不同。例如：

- GEMM 场景中，Cube 侧 L0C→UB 搬运走 PIPE_FIX，所以 Cube 侧 set/wait 用 PIPE_FIX
- GEMM 场景中，Vector 侧 UB→GM 搬运走 PIPE_MTE3，所以 Vector 侧 set/wait 用 PIPE_MTE3
- AscendC 官方文档中，mode 0 的 set 示例使用 PIPE_MTE3（不是 PIPE_FIX）
- 其他场景中，可能还需要 PIPE_V、PIPE_M、PIPE_MTE2 等

如果 wait 端 stall 了错误的流水线，需要同步的流水线不会被阻塞，导致读到未就绪数据。

### flag_id 参数

A5 平台上 flag_id 地址空间为 0-31：0-15 对应 AIV0，16-31 对应 AIV1（+16 偏移）。mode 4 场景中，AIC 需要用不同的 flag_id 分别通知两个 AIV 子核。

## 问题列表

### 问题 1：DSL facade 不支持 mode 0 和 mode 1

当前 PTO DSL facade 只提供了两组跨核同步函数：

- `set_cross_flag` / `wait_cross_flag`（对应 mode 2 语义）
- `set_intra_flag` / `wait_intra_flag`（对应 mode 4 语义）

mode 0（跨 block 同类型核同步）和 mode 1（AIV 子核间同步）在 DSL facade 层完全没有对应接口。TileLang 接口暴露了 mode_id 参数，用户可以使用 0/1/2/4 四种模式，我们需要 codegen 完整覆盖。

### 问题 2：所有跨核同步 facade 的 pipe 限制过严

当前四个 facade 函数各自只允许一个固定的 pipe 值：

| facade 函数 | 当前允许的 pipe |
|-------------|---------------|
| `set_cross_flag` | 仅 PIPE_FIX |
| `wait_cross_flag` | 仅 PIPE_FIX |
| `set_intra_flag` | 仅 PIPE_MTE3 |
| `wait_intra_flag` | 仅 PIPE_V |

但 pipe 的合法取值应由调用方根据实际数据流决定，不同 mode_id 和不同操作侧（Cube/Vector）需要的 pipe 不同。当前的限制导致大量合法用法无法表达。

以 GEMM 场景（mode 4）为例，需要 4 种 set/wait 组合：

| 场景 | 操作 | 需要的 pipe | 当前 facade | 能否使用 |
|------|------|-----------|------------|---------|
| Cube→Vector 通知 | set | PIPE_FIX | `set_cross_flag` | ✅ |
| Cube 等 Vector | wait | PIPE_FIX | `wait_cross_flag` | ✅ |
| Vector→Cube 通知 | set | PIPE_MTE3 | `set_intra_flag` | ✅ |
| Vector 等 Cube | wait | PIPE_MTE3 | `wait_intra_flag` | ❌ 只允许 PIPE_V |

其中"Vector 等 Cube"无法表达：AIV 侧等待 AIC 把 GEMM 结果搬到 UB，然后在 MTE3 流水线上执行 UB→GM 搬运。wait 必须 stall MTE3 而不是 V，否则 MTE3 不会等待信号就执行搬运，产生数据竞争。

除 GEMM 外，AscendC 官方文档中 mode 0 的 set 示例使用的是 PIPE_MTE3（不是 PIPE_FIX），也无法通过 `set_cross_flag` 表达。其他场景中 PIPE_V、PIPE_M、PIPE_MTE2 等 pipe 也是合法选择。

这意味着当前每个 facade 的 pipe 限制都过严，不只是某个函数的问题。

### 问题 3：event_id 限制为 0-7，A5 平台需要 0-31

当前 DSL facade 的所有四个函数都通过 `_validate_static_event_id` 将静态 event_id 限制在 0-7 范围内。

A5 平台硬件支持 0-31 的 event_id 地址空间（0-15 给 AIV0，16-31 给 AIV1，通过 +16 偏移区分目标子核）。mode 4 场景中，AIC 需要用 flag_id 6 通知 AIV0、用 flag_id 22（=6+16）通知 AIV1，但 22 会被 DSL facade 拒绝。

## 诉求

我们希望 PTO DSL facade 能完整覆盖 用户项目中 跨核同步接口的全部功能。具体诉求：

1. **支持 mode 0 和 mode 1**：提供对应 facade 或暴露 `ffts_mode` 参数让调用方指定模式
2. **移除 pipe 限制**：所有跨核同步 facade 应接受任意合法 pipe 值，由调用方根据实际数据流决定，而不是在 facade 层硬编码
3. **扩展 event_id 范围**：静态 event_id 范围应支持到 0-31（A5 平台）

或者，提供一个更底层的统一 facade（如 `pto.sync_flag(pipe, event_id, mode=2)`），让调用方自行指定 mode、pipe、event_id，不受当前的逐函数 pipe 限制。


### Motivation / use case

--

### Proposed API / behavior

## #990 [Feature] PTO不支持AscendC::SetHF32Mode(AscendC::HF32Mode::ENABLE); AscendC::SetHF32TransMode(AscendC::HF32TransMode::NEAREST_ZERO);设置全局HF模式

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/990
- Created: 2026-07-24T03:40:04Z
- Updated: 2026-08-07T06:53:46Z
- Closed: 2026-08-07T06:53:46Z

### Body

### Summary

### Ascend C++ 后端的实现（正常）
`T.set_hf32_mode()` 用于控制 Ascend Cube 单元的 HF32 模式（将 fp32 输入截断为 19 位尾数后再做矩阵乘，以换取约 2x 吞吐）。该 API 在 Ascend C++ 后端正常工作，但在 PTO 后端**无 handler
`codegen_ascend.cc:1058-1072` 有完整 handler，将 IR `ascend_set_hf32_mode(mode_int)` 翻译为两条 AscendC runtime 调用：

```cpp
// mode == 0 (disable)
AscendC::SetHF32Mode(AscendC::HF32Mode::DISABLE);

// mode == 1 (nearest_zero)
AscendC::SetHF32Mode(AscendC::HF32Mode::ENABLE);
AscendC::SetHF32TransMode(AscendC::HF32TransMode::NEAREST_ZERO);

// mode == 2 (nearest_even)
AscendC::SetHF32Mode(AscendC::HF32Mode::ENABLE);
AscendC::SetHF32TransMode(AscendC::HF32TransMode::NEAREST_EVEN);
### PTO 后端的现状（缺失）

`codegen_pto.cc` 中**完全没有** `ascend_set_hf32_mode` 的 handler。IR 到达 codegen 时，`VisitExpr_` 遍历到该 op，发现无匹配分支，落入末尾的兜底逻辑（L1892-1895）：

## #993 [Feature] PTO DSL 缺失的 SIMT 标量运算-影响 RNG 算子的完整实现

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/993
- Created: 2026-07-24T09:09:46Z
- Updated: 2026-08-13T11:32:28Z
- Closed: 2026-08-13T11:32:28Z

### Body

### Summary

## 背景

在 TileLang 的 PTO 后端 codegen 中，我们需要将 `T.rng_init` / `T.rng_rand` / `T.rng_rand_float` 三个算子 lowering 到 PTO DSL。这三个算子实现的是 Philox 4x32-10 随机数生成算法，要求在 `@pto.simt` 函数内以标量运算逐线程执行。

AscendC 后端已完整实现该功能（通过 C++ 头文件直接调用标量数学函数），但 PTO DSL 缺少若干关键 API，导致我们只能用近似方法实现，与 AscendC 的实现结果存在差异。

## 问题一：缺少标量三角函数（sin / cos）

### 现象

`T.rng_rand_float(dist="normal")` 需要将均匀分布随机数转换为标准正态分布。标准做法是 Box-Muller 变换：

```
z0 = sqrt(-2 * ln(u1)) * cos(2π * u2)
z1 = sqrt(-2 * ln(u1)) * sin(2π * u2)
```

### PTO 现状

- `pto` 命名空间下没有 `sin` / `cos` 函数
- `scalar` 模块也没有 `sin` / `cos`
- 全仓库搜索（包括测试文件）未找到任何三角函数的使用

### 我们的临时方案

用 Irwin-Hall 近似代替：生成 12 个 [0,1) 均匀随机数求和后减 6，近似服从 N(0,1)。

### 与 AscendC 的差异

| 方面 | AscendC（Box-Muller） | PTO（Irwin-Hall 近似） |
|------|----------------------|----------------------|
| 精度 | 精确 | 尾部有偏差（±3σ 以外误差较大） |
| 每次输出 | 2 个正态随机数 | 1 个 |
| 计算量 | 2 次 uniform + 三角/对数/开方运算 | 12 次 uniform + 11 次加法 |
| 可复现性 | 与 CUDA curand 的正态分布序列不同 | 与 AscendC 的正态分布序列不同 |

### 期望

PTO DSL 在 `@pto.simt` 上下文中提供标量 `sin` / `cos` 运算（或提供 Box-Muller 的内置封装），使 PTO 后端能生成与 AscendC 相同的正态分布随机数序列。

## 问题二：缺少 SIMT 级别的随机数生成原语

### 现象

`T.rng_init` / `T.rng_rand` / `T.rng_rand_float` 的语义是 per-thread 的（每个 SIMT 线程独立维护 PRNG 状态，逐次调用返回随机数），对应 CUDA curand 的 device API。

### PTO 现状

PTO DSL 有 `pto.trandom` 操作，但它是 **vector engine 的 tile 级操作**：
- 一次调用产出一整块 ui32 随机数（如 4×256）
- 无状态管理（每次调用独立计算，不支持连续抽取）
- 只输出 uint32，不提供 uniform/normal 转换
- 运行在 vector engine（lane 并行），不是 SIMT（thread 并行）

这与我们的需求不匹配：我们需要每个线程维护独立的 Philox 状态，支持多次调用 `rand()` 并推进内部计数器。

### 我们的临时方案

用 `pto.mulhi` + 标量运算（`*`、`^`、`+`）手动实现完整的 Philox 4x32-10 算法，封装为 Python 类 `PhiloxRNG`（放在 `tilelang/contrib/ptodsl/rng.py`）。

### 期望

PTO DSL 提供 SIMT 级别的随机数生成原语，或提供状态管理机制使 `pto.trandom` 能支持 per-thread 的连续抽取语义。

## 总结

| # | 问题 | 严重程度 | 当前临时方案 |
|---|------|---------|------------|
| 1 | 缺少标量 sin/cos | 中 | Irwin-Hall 近似（精度有损） |
| 2 | 缺少 SIMT 级 RNG 原语 | 中 | 手动实现 Philox 算法 |

这两个问题导致 PTO 后端的 RNG 实现与 AscendC 不完全一致（正态分布精度有损、随机数序列不同）。

### Motivation / use case

--

### Proposed API / behavior

_No response_

### Alternatives considered

_No response_

### Additional context

## #995 [Bug] 0.51 lowers cmo.cacheinvalid on a partition_tensor_view to an uncompilable DCCI call

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/995
- Created: 2026-07-24T10:22:30Z
- Updated: 2026-07-27T03:23:38Z
- Closed: 2026-07-27T03:23:38Z

### Body

### Component

EmitC / Codegen (lib/PTO/Transforms/PTOToEmitC.cpp)

### Description

Since 0.51, `pto.cmo.cacheinvalid <partition_tensor_view> single_cache_line` is
lowered to a call that PTOAS's own emitted helper cannot compile.

The helper PTOAS emits is pointer-only:

```cpp
template <typename Ptr>
static AICORE inline void PTOAS__DCCI_SINGLE_CACHE_LINE(Ptr ptr) {
  dcci((__gm__ void*)ptr, cache_line_t::SINGLE_CACHE_LINE);
}
```

but for a `partition_tensor_view` operand the argument passed in is the
materialised `GlobalTensor<...>` object, not its address. `GlobalTensor` has no
conversion to `__gm__ void*`, so every kernel carrying this op fails to compile.

I checked pto-isa at both the pinned commit `83d01313` and current `main`
(`439faf48`): `GlobalTensor` exposes `data()` and `SetAddr()` and has no
conversion operator to `__gm__ void*` in either, so this is not a pto-isa version
skew — no pto-isa revision makes the emitted cast valid.

0.50 also accepted this IR but emitted **no** call at all for it (only the helper
template definition), so the op was silently a no-op. Either behaviour is a
problem, but the 0.51 one is a hard build break.

Impact on the PyPTO side: this takes down 36 `dist-system-tests` (all L3
collectives) and the DeepSeek-V4-Flash `moe` model example when moving the
toolchain pin from 0.50 to 0.51. PyPTO's `InsertCommFence` pass emits this op to
implement the publish side of the data-before-signal contract; we have had to
suspend emitting it entirely to get off 0.50.

### Reproduction (minimal)

`repro.pto`:

```mlir
module attributes {pto.target_arch = "a2a3"} {
  func.func @k(%arg0: !pto.ptr<f32>) attributes {pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<vector>} {
  %c16_index = arith.constant 16 : index
  %c1_index = arith.constant 1 : index
  %c0_index = arith.constant 0 : index
  %view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg0, shape = [%c16_index, %c16_index], strides = [%c16_index, %c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>}: !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32>
  %pview = pto.partition_view %view, offsets = [%c0_index, %c0_index], sizes = [%c16_index, %c16_index] : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<16x16xf32>
  pto.cmo.cacheinvalid %pview single_cache_line : !pto.partition_tensor_view<16x16xf32>
  return
  }
}
```

```bash
ptoas repro.pto -o repro.cpp --pto-level=level3
```

Then compile `repro.cpp` for the target (or inspect the emitted call directly —
the type error is visible without compiling).

### Expected behavior

`pto.cmo.cacheinvalid` on a `partition_tensor_view` lowers to a `dcci` on the
view's base address — e.g. passing `v7.data()`, or giving the helper a
`GlobalTensor` overload that extracts the address.

If tensor-view operands are not intended to be supported at all, PTOAS should
reject the op with a diagnostic rather than emit uncompilable C++ (0.51) or
silently drop it (0.50).

### Actual behavior / error logs

0.51 emits:

```cpp
GlobalTensor<float, pto::Shape<1, 1, 1, 16, 16>, pto::Stride<256, 256, 256, 16, 1>, pto::Layout::ND> v7 = ...;
PTOAS__DCCI_SINGLE_CACHE_LINE(v7);
```

which fails to compile:

```text
dispatch_meta.cpp:54:8: error: cannot cast from type
  'pto::GlobalTensor<int, pto::Shape<1, 1, 1, 1, 32>, pto::Stride<32, 32, 32, 32, 1>, pto::Layout::ND>'
  to pointer type '__gm__ void *'
  dcci((__gm__ void*)ptr, cache_line_t::SINGLE_CACHE_LINE);
       ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
dispatch_meta.cpp:144:5: note: in instantiation of function template specialization
  'PTOAS__DCCI_SINGLE_CACHE_LINE<pto::GlobalTensor<...>>' requested here
    PTOAS__DCCI_SINGLE_CACHE_LINE(v45);
    ^
```

0.50, same input and flags, emits the helper template but no call site — diffing
the two outputs shows exactly one added line:

```diff
   TSTORE(v13, v6);
+  PTOAS__DCCI_SINGLE_CACHE_LINE(v13);
```

### Related: the pointer form is not a workaround

Feeding a raw pointer instead is rejected by both versions:

- `pto.cmo.cacheinvalid %ptr single_cache_line` (no type annotation, which is what
  PyPTO currently emits for the pointer form) — parse error `expected ':'` on 0.50
  and 0.51 alike.
- with an explicit `: !pto.ptr<f32>` it parses, then fails in a pass on both:
  `error: addptr must feed make_tensor_view, initialize_l2g2l_pipe(gm_addr) or
  load/store_scalar for lowering`.

So there is currently no form of `pto.cmo.cacheinvalid` on a specific region that
produces working code. The whole-GM form
(`pto.cmo.cacheinvalid all #pto.address_space<gm>`) is fine — both versions lower
it identically to `dcci((__gm__ void*)0, cache_line_t::ENTIRE_DATA_CACHE)`.

### Git commit

Release binaries: `ptoas 0.51` (`ptoas-bin-aarch64.tar.gz`,
sha256 `39f3fb6da1fa1dc9f206d77f11f5be5b6412e1ac1a71b86e1555907e75bf3a32`),
compared against `ptoas 0.50`
(sha256 `acf7b316bedccf0689971d2dc92f9f80621ab5eba131d805317e01c766c1dc2c`).

### Target Ascend arch

a2a3

### PTOAS build level

level3

- State: open
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1000
- Created: 2026-07-27T01:57:16Z
- Updated: 2026-07-28T02:55:36Z
- Closed: 

### Body

### Summary

在PTOAS/PTODSL上支持loop unroll hint以支持Tilelang-PTO后端将T.unroll(..., explicit=False) lower成对等语义

### Motivation / use case

Tilelang中T.unroll(..., explicit=False)语法在CUDA/ASC后端会生成一个loop unroll hint (#pragma unroll)，表示建议编译器进行unroll，实际unroll行为仍由编译器内部cost model决定。而PTOAS/PTODSL当前仅提供了pto.static_range语法，该语法在DSL前端对循环做强制展开，未考虑寄存器压力等cost model，对循环次数较多的loop使用会导致编译报错。因此亟需在PTOAS/PTODSL侧也提供与#pragma unroll类似功能的语法，实现编译器侧unroll。

### Proposed API / behavior

# PTOAS/PTODSL Loop Unroll Hint 开发计划

## 总体目标

在 PTODSL 中扩展 `pto.for_`，并新增与 Python `range` 对应的 `pto.range`。用户可以继续使用 Python 原生循环语法，同时通过 `pto.range` 携带 loop unroll hint：

```python
for i in pto.range(0, N, unroll="full"):
    ...
```

```python
for i in pto.range(0, N, unroll_factor=4):
    ...
```

普通 Python 循环保持不变：

```python
for i in range(0, N):
    ...
```

阶段一由 Bisheng/CCE 执行展开，阶段二由 PTOAS 原生展开。

## 阶段一：PTODSL 接口与 Python AST Rewrite

### `pto.for_` 扩展

在现有接口上增加可选参数：

```python
pto.for_(
    start,
    stop,
    *,
    step,
    unroll=None,
    unroll_factor=None,
)
```

约束：

- `unroll="full"` 表示完全展开。
- `unroll_factor=N` 表示指定展开因子。
- 两者互斥，factor 必须为正整数。
- 未指定 hint 时保持现有行为和 IR 不变。
- `.carry(...)` 继续附着于同一个 loop builder；hint 不能改变 loop-carried value 语义。

### `pto.range` 设计

新增 Python range-like 前端接口：

```python
pto.range(stop, *, unroll=None, unroll_factor=None)
pto.range(start, stop, *, step=1, unroll=None, unroll_factor=None)
```

它只用于 PTODSL tracing/AST rewrite，不作为普通 Python runtime iterable 使用。

设计要求：

- 保持 Python `range` 的 start/stop/step 语义。
- 支持整数常量、PTODSL 编译期值和 runtime loop bound。
- 支持 `unroll="full"` 和 `unroll_factor=N`。
- 参数校验规则与 `pto.for_` 完全一致。
- `pto.range(...)` 不引入独立的 loop IR；它只是为原生 `for` 携带 hint 的 frontend marker。

### AST Rewrite

扩展现有 Python 原生循环改写逻辑：

- `for i in range(...)` 继续按现有规则转换为无 hint 的 `pto.for_`。
- `for i in pto.range(...)` 被识别为带 hint 的循环。
- AST rewrite 解析 `pto.range` 的参数，规范化为：

```python
with pto.for_(
    start,
    stop,
    step=step,
    unroll=unroll,
    unroll_factor=unroll_factor,
) as i:
    ...
```

- 两种写法必须生成相同的 loop bounds、step、attribute 和 SSA 语义：

```python
for i in pto.range(..., unroll_factor=4):
    ...
```

```python
with pto.for_(..., unroll_factor=4) as i:
    ...
```

- `break`、`continue`、loop-carried value 等现有原生控制流限制保持不变，并提供针对 `pto.range` 的明确诊断。
- 嵌套循环只影响直接使用 `pto.range` 的层级。
- `pto.range` 不得被误识别为 `pto.static_range`；后者仍保持 trace-time 展开语义。

## Loop Hint 的 IR 表达

统一将 `pto.for_` / `pto.range` 的 hint 编码到目标 `scf.for`：

```mlir
{pto.unroll = "full"}
{pto.unroll_factor = 4}
```

需要实现：

- PTODSL builder 设置 attribute。
- verifier 校验类型、互斥关系和 factor 范围。
- attribute 在 PTOAS pipeline 中保持不丢失。
- 对不支持的循环形态保留原循环并产生明确诊断，不得静默改变语义。

## 阶段一：Bisheng/CCE Bypass

在 PTOAS lowering 阶段将 loop attribute 转换为 Bisheng/CCE 可识别的 pragma 或等价 metadata：

- full hint 映射到 CCE full-unroll hint。
- factor hint 映射到 CCE factor-unroll hint。
- 确保 hint 出现在目标循环的有效作用域中，并保留到 Bisheng 输入。
- 对无法映射的 hint 提供 warning/error 策略；默认保留原循环语义。
- 阶段一不复制循环体，不生成 remainder loop。

## 阶段二：PTOAS 原生 Loop Unroll

扩展现有 `PTOUnrollSIMTFor`，或实现通用 loop-unroll pass：

- full unroll：复制静态循环体并替换 induction variable。
- factor unroll：生成展开主循环和 remainder loop。
- 首版限制为静态 lower/upper/step、正 step 和可计算 trip count。
- 正确处理 loop-carried SSA、嵌套循环、条件分支和 memory side effects。
- 明确 barrier、pipeline 和其他同步操作在展开时的复制与顺序规则。
- 在 `scf.for` 转 CFG/LLVM 前执行。
- 展开后运行 canonicalize、SCCP、CSE 和必要的 dead-code elimination。
- 通过配置保证阶段一 CCE bypass 与阶段二 native unroll 不会对同一循环重复展开。

## 测试计划

### PTODSL/API

- `pto.for_(..., unroll="full")` 生成 full attribute。
- `pto.for_(..., unroll_factor=4)` 生成 factor attribute。
- `for i in pto.range(...)` 可被 AST rewrite 正确改写。
- `range`、`pto.range`、`pto.for_` 三者在无 hint 时行为兼容。
- `pto.range` 的 start/stop/step 组合与 Python `range` 一致。
- `.carry(...)`、嵌套循环和 runtime bound 测试。
- 非法参数、冲突参数、动态 factor 和不支持控制流产生稳定诊断。

### PTOAS/Bisheng

- PTODSL frontend 编译通过。
- attribute verifier 和 lowering 测试通过。
- full/factor hint 生成预期 CCE pragma/metadata。
- Bisheng 编译通过，并确认 hint 未在中间产物中丢失。
- 使用 SIMT/VF kernel 完成 PTODSL -> PTOAS -> Bisheng 闭环验证。

### Native Unroll

- full unroll 展开次数和 induction variable 替换。
- factor unroll 的整除、不整除、trip count 小于 factor、0/1 次迭代。
- 嵌套循环、条件分支、loop-carried value 和同步操作。
- 动态边界、负 step 和不支持场景的诊断。
- 阶段一/阶段二互斥配置回归测试。

## 默认假设

- 本计划只覆盖 PTOAS/PTODSL，不包含 TileLang codegen 修改。
- `pto.for_` 是实际 loop builder，`pto.range` 是 Python 原生 `for` 的 hint carrier。
- 普通 `range` 与现有 `pto.static_range` 的语义保持不变。
- 阶段一由 Bisheng/CCE 完成循环展开；阶段二才由 PTOAS 修改循环结构。
- 首版支持 full unroll 和指定 factor，不承诺任意动态循环均可展开。


### Alternatives considered

_No response_

### Additional context

_No response_

## #1003 [Feature] Support mixed FP8×FP4 (W4A8) dtype pair in pto.tmatmul.mx / pto.tmatmul.mx.acc / pto.tmatmul.mx.bias for A5 architecture

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1003
- Created: 2026-07-27T03:58:27Z
- Updated: 2026-07-28T10:54:44Z
- Closed: 2026-07-28T10:54:43Z

### Body

## 1. Summary
This issue targets extending supported input element-type combinations of three existing PTO matrix multiplication ops on A5, instead of introducing brand-new operators. The op signatures remain unchanged; only verifier logic and TileLib template low-precision type whitelists will be extended to support mixed MX precision pairs (primary target: W4A8).

### Affected ops & code locations
1. `pto.tmatmul.mx ins(%a, %a_scale, %b, %b_scale) outs(%dst)`
   File: `include/PTO/IR/PTOOps.td` Line 1009
2. `pto.tmatmul.mx.acc`
3. `pto.tmatmul.mx.bias`

### New mixed MX dtype pairs to be enabled
1. `(f8e4m3, f4e2m1x2)` → A8W4: Activation MXFP8 × Weight MXFP4 (mandatory for DeepSeek-V4 routing experts)
2. `(f4e2m1x2, f8e4m3)` → Reverse symmetric pair for potential future use

### Fixed preserved type constraints
- Per-block scale tensors (`a_scale`/`b_scale`): always `f8E8M0`
- Accumulator / intermediate `c_in` / output `dst`: always `f32`
- Fixed block size = 32, shared exponent via f8E8M0 scaling, consistent with existing MX quantization spec.

## 2. Semantics
Element-wise computation semantics are fully identical to current homogeneous-precision-only `tmatmul.mx`: low-precision matrix multiplication with per-block-32 f8E8M0 scale factors, followed by FP32 accumulation.

The only new capability is allowing LHS and RHS matrices to use different low-precision dtypes:
- LHS matrix: `f8e4m3` (FP8 E4M3FN)
- RHS matrix: packed `f4e2m1x2` (packed FP4 E2M1)

Each block is dequantized to FP32 before dot-product calculation, fully compliant with OCP MX quantization specification. All other input/output dtype rules stay unchanged.

### 2.1 Verifier Logic Changes
Current A5 MX type validator `isA5MxInputTypePair` enforces homogeneous pairs only: both FP8 or both FP4. We need to relax this rule to allow the two mixed pairs listed above.

Architecture restriction remains: mixed FP8×FP4 MX matmul is **A5-only**. A2/A3 targets will still fail validation when mixed dtype pairs are used.

## 3. Motivation & Use Case
DeepSeek-V4 hybrid MXFP8-MXFP4 inference requires separate quantization schemes for linear layers:
1. Routing experts: W4A8 (MXFP4 weight × MXFP8 activation, block=32, f8E8M0 per-block scale)
2. Shared experts: W8A8 homogeneous MXFP8 matmul (already supported)

### 3.1 Upstream AscendC Compatibility Reference
AscendC has already implemented this mixed-precision matmul via `aclnnGroupedMatmul` (NZ weight quantization, arch35/950). Its checker `IsMxA8W4NZ()` natively accepts `FLOAT8_E4M3FN × FLOAT4_E2M1`:
- Code path: `ops-transformer/gmm/grouped_matmul/op_api/grouped_matmul_weight_quant_950_checker.cpp` Line 61
- Multiple hardcoded `"fp8_e4m3fn-float4_e2m1"` type pair strings in checker logic.

Official model guide reference:
`cann-recipes-infer/docs/models/deepseek_v4/deepseek_v4_inference_guide.md` §Hybrid MXFP8-MXFP4 (Lines 248–265), explicitly specifying W4A8 for routing experts and W8A8 for shared experts.

## 4. Current PTOAS Limitation Analysis
PTOAS lacks W4A8 mixed MX matmul support due to explicit hard-coded whitelist restrictions (not missing backend implementation):
1. IR Verifier whitelist `isA5MxInputTypePair` (`lib/PTO/IR/PTO.cpp` Line 7332) only permits homogeneous FP8/FP8 or FP4/FP4 pairs.
   Mismatch error string: `expects A5 mx lhs/rhs element types to be a supported fp8/fp8 or fp4/fp4 pair` (PTO.cpp Line 7337)
2. TileLib template `_LOW_PRECISION_PAIRS` (tmatmul_mx_template.py Lines 14–23) only registers 8 homogeneous low-precision pairs; no FP8×FP4 mixed entry.

### 4.1 Codebase Status Check
- Base PTOAS version: v0.52, HEAD commit `26212b2` (2026-07-25)
- Full cross-branch git log search shows no existing commits for mixed FP8/FP4, W4A8 or mixed-precision `mad_mx`; no parallel ongoing development tracked for this feature.

## 5. Lowering & Codegen Requirements
1. Existing lowering pipeline unchanged: PTO IR → TileLib CKernel → EmitC TMATMUL_MX intrinsic
2. Precondition to confirm with hardware/ISA team: Whether A5 Cube ISA provides native mixed-precision FP8×FP4 MAD instruction for MX. Generic `mad_mx` intrinsic needs mixed dtype pair registration to work.
3. TileLib template modification points:
   - Register new mixed pairs in `_LOW_PRECISION_PAIRS`
     - Primary template: `lib/TileOps/tmatmul_mx_template.py` Line 14
     - Ptodsl mirror template: `ptodsl/ptodsl/tilelib/templates/a5/tmatmul_mx.py` Line 24
4. Implement A5 CKernel path for `pto.mad_mx` that accepts mixed-precision operands; apply identical changes to `.mx` / `.mx.acc` / `.mx.bias`.
5. Dependency note: If no native mixed MAD instruction exists in A5 Cube ISA, this PTOAS enhancement cannot be completed independently; corresponding tile implementation must be delivered from pto-isa layer first.

## 6. Sample PTO IR Snippet (W4A8 Routing Expert Matmul)
```llvm
// Matmul MX for DeepSeek-V4 routing expert: act=FP8E4M3FN, weight=packed FP4E2M1
// Scale dtype f8E8M0, accumulation/output f32
%a    = ... : !pto.tile<16x128xf8E4M3>
%a_s  = ... : !pto.tile<16x4xf8E8M0>     // ceil(128 / block_size=32) = 4
%b    = ... : !pto.tile<128x128xf4E2M1x2>
%b_s  = ... : !pto.tile<4x128xf8E8M0>
%dst  = ... : !pto.tile<16x128xf32>
pto.tmatmul.mx ins(%a, %a_s, %b, %b_s : ...) outs(%dst : ...)
```

## 7. Proposed Code Change Breakdown (for maintainer reference)
### 7.1 IR Verifier Modifications
1. Extend `isA5MxInputTypePair` (`PTO.cpp` Line 7332) to whitelist `(f8e4m3, f4e2m1x2)` and reversed `(f4e2m1x2, f8e4m3)`
2. Update error message string in `verifyA5MxTypeTriple` (PTO.cpp Line 7342) to document allowed mixed dtype pairs
3. Reuse the updated type pair predicate for validation of `.mx.acc` and `.mx.bias`

### 7.2 TileLib CKernel Template Modifications
1. Append FP8×FP4 mixed entry to `_LOW_PRECISION_PAIRS` in both primary template and ptodsl mirror template
2. Implement or coordinate with pto-isa team for A5 native `mad_mx` tile supporting mixed-precision operands; mark pto-isa dependency if hardware instruction is missing

### 7.3 Test Coverage Additions
1. Add lit/pytest test cases covering mixed `(f8e4m3, f4e2m1x2)` across all three ops: `tmatmul.mx` / `tmatmul.mx.acc` / `tmatmul.mx.bias`
2. Golden reference calculation strictly follows OCP MX dequantization rules:
   - Scale factor formula: `scale = 2^(f8E8M0_value - 127)`
   - FP4 E2M1 fixed quantization levels: `{0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6}`
   - FP8 E4M3 rounding mode: RTE, maximum representable value = 448

## 8. Base Git Commit (Optional)
`26212b2` (ptoas v0.52 base snapshot, commit date 2026-07-25)

## 9. Alternatives considered
None

## 10. Additional context
None

## #1004 [VPTO] PTODSL 默认 kernel_kind 被序列化为显式 kind，导致 C/V split 冲突

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1004
- Created: 2026-07-27T08:49:14Z
- Updated: 2026-08-03T01:46:25Z
- Closed: 2026-08-03T01:46:25Z

### Body

## 背景与目标

TileLang 正在将手写 AIC/AIV GEMM 示例 `examples/ascend/example_gemm_mix_manual.py` 迁移到 VPTO 路径的 PTODSL。迁移入口需要支持未显式指定 `kernel_kind` 的 `@pto.jit(..., backend="vpto")`：同一 entry 中的 Vector TileOp 和 Cube TileOp 应被 VPTO 分别编译为 Vector 与 Cube child。

本 issue 不建议引入 `kernel_kind="mixed"`。PTODSL 现有默认值 `module_spec.kernel_kind="vector"` 及其 `kernel_kind_explicit=False` 需要继续保留，供 native build 决定 host 编译架构；问题在于该默认值不应被当作用户写入 PTO IR 的显式 kernel kind。

## 复现 POC

下面的 POC 使用真实 `pto.tileop()`，故 PTODSL 会根据 TileOp 自动形成 `pto.section.vector` 与 `pto.section.cube`。它有意没有传入 `kernel_kind=`：

```python
from ptodsl import pto

@pto.jit(name="default_kind_cv_tileop_probe", target="a5")
def default_kind_cv_tileop_probe():
    with pto.tileop():
        zero = pto.const(0, dtype=pto.i64)
        source = pto.castptr(zero, pto.ptr(pto.f32, "ub"))
        destination = pto.castptr(zero, pto.ptr(pto.f32, "ub"))
        value = pto.vlds(source, 0, pto.vreg_type(64, pto.f32))
        pto.vsts(value, destination, 0, pto.pset_b32(pto.MaskPattern.ALL))

    with pto.tileop():
        zero = pto.const(0, dtype=pto.i64)
        lhs = pto.castptr(zero, pto.ptr(pto.f16, "left"))
        rhs = pto.castptr(zero, pto.ptr(pto.f16, "right"))
        acc = pto.castptr(zero, pto.ptr(pto.f32, "acc"))
        extent = pto.const(16, dtype=pto.i64)
        pto.mad(lhs, rhs, acc, extent, extent, extent)
```

该 POC 用于隔离 PTODSL trace 与 C/V split，不是完整可执行的 VPTO kernel：其中 `pto.vlds` 尚未放入合法的 `pto.vecscope`。这不会影响对 split 的观察，因为默认路径在到达 vector verifier 前已于 split pass 失败。

## 已验证的实际行为

在上游 `main` 的 `d852dd2` 上：

1. `pto.jit` 在省略 `kernel_kind` 时正确保留 `module_spec.kernel_kind="vector"`，并标记 `kernel_kind_explicit=False`。
2. `ptodsl/ptodsl/_tracing/module_builder.py::_apply_child_module_attrs` 没有检查 `kernel_kind_explicit`。因此它仍将默认值写入 backend child：

   ```mlir
   module attributes {pto.backend = "vpto",
                      pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<vector>} {
     func.func @default_kind_cv_tileop_probe() attributes {pto.entry} {
       pto.section.vector { ... }
       pto.section.cube { ... }
       return
     }
   }
   ```

3. `VPTOSplitCVModule` 将这个 `pto.kernel_kind<vector>` 当作显式 authored intent。在同一 module 内发现 `pto.section.cube` 后，`verifyExplicitKernelKindMatchesSections` 直接报错并终止 emission：

   ```text
   error: conflicts with explicit pto.kernel_kind on its module
   Error: VPTO emission pipeline failed.
   ```

因此此前“只生成 vector child、未生成 cube child”的结论不准确。实际是 C/V split 在冲突校验阶段失败，不会产生可继续使用的单 vector 输出。

## 单变量对照

仅手工删除真实生成 `.pto` 的 backend child `pto.kernel_kind<vector>` 属性，不改动任何 operation 或 section：

- `VPTOSplitCVModule` 成功拆出一个 vector child 与一个 cube child；
- 两个 child 分别保留对应的 vector/cube 指令；
- split 之后才因 POC 中 `pto.vlds` 缺少 `pto.vecscope` 触发独立的 vector verifier 错误。

这证明现有 split pass 已能处理“无 kind 的 backend-partitioned child 含 C/V section”这一形态。本 issue 的失败由前端把默认值错误物化为 IR 属性引起。

## 期望语义与修复边界

PTODSL tracing 应区分运行时默认值和用户显式语义：

1. 默认路径继续保留 `module_spec.kernel_kind="vector"` 和 `kernel_kind_explicit=False`，不改变 native build 的选择逻辑。
2. 仅当用户显式传入 `kernel_kind=`，即 `kernel_kind_explicit=True` 时，`_apply_child_module_attrs` 才向 PTO IR backend child 写入 `pto.kernel_kind`。
3. 默认且同时有 Cube/Vector section 的 backend child 不带 `pto.kernel_kind`；现有 `VPTOSplitCVModule` 据此 materialize 出 Cube 和 Vector 两个 child。
4. 显式 `kernel_kind="cube"` 或 `kernel_kind="vector"` 继续保持现有的单-kind 行为。

针对这个默认-kind 冲突，不需要先改动 PTOAS 后端 split pass；首要修改点是 PTODSL `module_builder.py` 的 child 属性写入条件。

## 影响与回归

该问题阻塞手写 Cube+Vector GEMM 的 VPTO 迁移：默认 entry 无法通过 C/V split，因此不能进入后续 L0C 到 UB、AIC/AIV 同步和代码生成验证。纯 Cube GEMM 与 `PTOGemmL1Template` 不受此问题影响。

回归应使用一个补齐 `pto.vecscope` 的合法 TileOp POC，至少覆盖：

1. 未显式 `kernel_kind` 且同时含 C/V section：trace child 无 `pto.kernel_kind`，`--emit-vpto` 产生一个 Cube child 和一个 Vector child；
2. 显式 `kernel_kind="vector"`：仍只 materialize Vector；
3. 显式 `kernel_kind="cube"`：仍只 materialize Cube。

## 环境

复核基线：PTOAS upstream `main` commit `d852dd2`，VPTO A5 emission。上述结论基于生成 PTO IR、split pass IR dump 及单变量去属性对照。

---

## #1009 [VMI] expose PLT POST_UPDATE remaining from create_mask for multi-tile vdhist

- State: open
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1009
- Created: 2026-07-27T10:45:46Z
- Updated: 2026-07-27T11:48:06Z
- Closed: 

### Body

## Summary

`pto.vmi.create_mask(active_lanes, size=...)` returns only a mask. For an 8×256 `vdhist` sweep over a dynamic remaining count (TileLang group_count tail / partial copy tile), that forces **absolute per-tile lane counts**:

```python
for i in range(8):
    rem_from = n - i * 256          # independent SSA per tile
    mask = pto.vmi.create_mask(rem_from, size=256)
    acc = pto.vmi.vdhist(acc, src[i], mask)
```

The ISA-intended pattern is a **carried remaining scalar** with `plt_b8(..., POST_UPDATE)`:

```cpp
uint32_t rem = n;
for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    auto mask = plt_b8(rem, POST_UPDATE);  // rem updated in place
    dhistv2(hist, src[i], mask, Bin_N0);
}
```

Today this ideal path is expressible in raw CCE / `pto.plt_b8` / `pto.make_mask`, but **not** with `pto.vmi.vdhist`:

- `pto.plt_b8` returns `!pto.mask<b8>`, which `pto.vmi.vdhist` rejects (`operand #2 must be VMI logical mask type`)
- `pto.vmi.create_mask` lowers each call independently via `plt` and **discards** `scalar_out`, so remaining cannot chain across tiles

## Ask

Please add a VMI-surface API that returns remaining, e.g.:

```python
mask, remained = pto.vmi.create_mask(remained, size=256)  # or create_mask_post_update(...)
# remained usable as next create_mask / loop-carried i32/index
```

Requirements:

1. Result mask must be a VMI logical mask accepted by `vdhist` / other VMI ops
2. `remained` must be the PLT `POST_UPDATE` scalar_out (or equivalent), so an 8-tile unroll can share one remaining counter without recomputing `min(256, max(0, n - i*256))` / rematerializing 8 absolute counts
3. Documented interaction with TileLang `T.vmi.create_mask` so group_count-style kernels can lower to this path

## Microbench (CCE, same 8×256 dhist slice)

Repro (in tilelang fork worktree):

`examples/ascend/vmi/plt_post_update_microbench/`

- `cce/dhist_plt_compare_cce.cpp` — absolute vs POST_UPDATE modes
- `run_cce_launch.py` — launch under `scripts/sim_dsl.sh`
- `abs_create_mask_vmi.py` — VMI absolute `create_mask(n - i*256)` IR reference

Setup: `n=1800`, `outer=64` → `512` tile iterations (`64×8`). Both modes **PASS** (identical hist vs golden).

### Opsim instr mix (`Ascend950PR_9599`)

| instr | absolute calls | post_update calls | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| RV_DHISTv2 | 512 | 512 | 0 |
| RV_VLD | 512 | 512 | 0 |
| RV_PLT | 512 | 512 | 0 |
| RV_SSUB | 512 | 0 | **+512** |
| RV_SMIN | 512 | 0 | **+512** |
| RV_SAND | 512 | 0 | **+512** |
| RV_SADD | 1024 | 0 | **+1024** |
| RV_SCMP | 576 | 64 | **+512** |
| RV_SMOV | 129 | 65 | **+64** |
| **total call_count** | **5208** | **2136** | **~2.4×** |

Absolute mode pays a full `min/max/sub` scalar chain per tile to rebuild the lane count that `POST_UPDATE` would have carried for free. Wall block time is still DHIST/VLD-dominated in this tiny kernel (~4.28 µs both), but the scalar tax matches what we see in TileLang group_count tail dumps (`+PLT/+SMOV` per unrolled hist tile).

### VMI absolute IR shape

```mlir
%rem = arith.subi %n, %c256 : index
%mask = pto.vmi.create_mask %rem : index -> !pto.vmi.mask<256xpred>
%acc = pto.vmi.vdhist %acc, %src, %mask ...
```

repeated per tile — no loop-carried remaining from PLT.

## Context

Came up while optimizing TileLang VMI `group_count` (`vdhist` over copy tiles with optional tail). Tail-enabled aligned cases show extra per-tile `RV_PLT`/`RV_SMOV` vs the no-tail path; expectation is one remaining scalar + POST_UPDATE PLTs across the 8 hist tiles.

Related surface that already does the right thing for non-VMI ops: `pto.make_mask` / `pto.plt_b*` returning `(mask, remained)` (see `tcmp_template.py`).

## #1022 [VMI] Lower scalar reduce store to ONEPT without pad-8

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1022
- Created: 2026-07-28T07:48:03Z
- Updated: 2026-07-29T05:55:18Z
- Closed: 2026-07-29T05:55:18Z

### Body

## Summary

VMI 的 reduce 结果目前无法沿用 CCE 的 `ONEPT_B32` scalar store 形态。
虽然前端可以表达 `vcadd` 后只 store 1 个有效 lane，但 lowering 会先生成
额外的 carrier materialization（如 `vdup`/`vadd`）以及普通 masked `vsts`。
生产 kernel 因此通常采用 pad-8 workaround：将一个 reduce 结果广播到 8 个
lane 后再 store，增加 vector 指令和 UB traffic。

## Impact

在 MHC post backward 的小 tile 路径上，pad-8 epilogue 是主要性能差距之一，
当前 kernel-side 对比显示该路径约有 40% 的上板性能影响。独立 reduce microbench
也显示 VMI 的 RVEC span 明显高于 CCE。

## Reproducer

Reproducer PR: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/pull/1013

The PR contains:

- VMI pad-8 kernel and CCE `ONEPT_B32` baseline;
- direct 1-lane VMI form;
- target MI form using `dist = "1PT_B32"`;
- cannsim correctness and RVEC measurements.

Pinned repro version: `vmi-v0.1.3`.

## Expected behavior

For a full reduction whose result is consumed by a 1-lane store, VMI lowering should
preserve the reduce carrier and select the corresponding `1PT_B32` store shape, without
pad-8 broadcast or unnecessary vector materialization.

The fix should preserve the existing VMI source-level semantics; a new scalar-store
API is not required if the existing 1-lane `vstore` form is sufficient.

## Acceptance criteria

- direct 1-lane VMI reduce/store lowers to `vsts {dist = "1PT_B32"}` or an equivalent
  ONEPT form;
- no pad-8 broadcast is required for this case;
- existing reduce/store correctness tests remain unchanged;
- the reproducer includes an instruction-level comparison against the CCE baseline.

## #1023 [VMI] Support two-stage ping-pong pipelines for VMI/MI kernels

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1023
- Created: 2026-07-28T07:48:10Z
- Updated: 2026-07-30T11:53:41Z
- Closed: 2026-07-30T11:53:40Z

### Body

## Summary

VMI/MI ported kernels need a two-stage ping-pong pipeline so MTE2, vector compute,
and MTE3 can overlap. The CCE implementation can express this schedule, but the VMI
porting path currently cannot reliably compile the equivalent pipeline.

The intended schedule is:

```text
for each block i:
  reuse slot = i % 2 only after the previous consumer releases it
  MTE2 -> V
  vector compute
  V -> MTE3
  MTE3 -> V before the slot is reused
```

## Impact

This is independent of the SIMD VF body and can affect most VMI ported kernels that
need multi-stage buffering. The current estimate is roughly 15% of on-board performance
for affected pipelines.

## Reproducer

Reproducer PR: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/pull/1014

The PR compares a CCE stages=2/block_k=1024 reference with VMI/MI fixtures and records
the current compile failures. The PTOAS reproducer should be kept focused on the actual
MTE2/V/MTE3 ping-pong and dynamic event-id sequence; layout-only failures and vector
values passed across the device function boundary should not be used as proxies for the
pipeline issue.

Related end-to-end reproducer (if accessible):

## Expected behavior

PTOAS should compile a two-stage VMI/MI persistent loop with two UB slots, dynamic
slot selection, and the required producer/consumer flags, matching the legal CCE
ping-pong schedule. The vector body may be a minimal operation; the issue is the
pipeline shell and its synchronization/lifetime handling.

## Acceptance criteria

- a self-contained PTOAS reproducer contains real MTE2/V/MTE3 operations and two
  dynamically reused slots;
- stages=2 compiles to valid VPTO/LLVM IR and Bisheng device object;
- no vector register values are passed as device function ABI parameters;
- a TileLang end-to-end case can use the resulting schedule without falling back to
  stages=1/chunked execution;
- correctness and an on-device overlap/bandwidth measurement are recorded.

## #1025 [VMI] 请教 4×T grouped reduce / partial group-slot broadcast 的最佳 lowering

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1025
- Created: 2026-07-28T08:01:48Z
- Updated: 2026-08-04T07:05:32Z
- Closed: 2026-08-04T07:05:32Z

### Body

## 背景

`per_block_cast_vmi.py` 正在把 MXFP8 per-block cast 的物理 strip 从 64 lanes
扩到 128 lanes。每个 strip 包含 4 个 32-column block，需要同时得到 4 个
amax，再把 4 个 reciprocal scale 广播回对应的 4×32 lanes。

源码中的实际主路径不是 `128xf16, group_num=4`，而是：

```text
128xbf16 row accumulator
  -> extf
128xf32
  -> group_reduce_maxf(num_groups=4)
4xf32 group slots
  -> scale/reciprocal elementwise math
4xf32 or 4xbf16 group slots
  -> broadcast to 128 lanes
128xf32 or 128xbf16
```

相关代码：

- `per_block_cast_vmi.py:202-215`：bf16 accumulator 在 `vcmax` 前 widen 到 f32
- `per_block_cast_vmi.py:230-268`：4 个 amax 上的 scale/reciprocal 计算与 compact store
- `per_block_cast_vmi.py:277-283`：从 4 个 compact slots 以 `dist_mode="brc"` 重载并广播

完整复现文件附件：

- [`per_block_cast_vmi.py`](https://gist.github.com/mouliangyu/e67d806078da717a16e3ce4ec1c28477)
- [raw 文件直接下载](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/mouliangyu/e67d806078da717a16e3ce4ec1c28477/raw/9c6b97be4e7bbbce3fd7d276acd6aeaf91418d23/per_block_cast_vmi.py)

Gist 使用 secret visibility（通过链接访问），内容为本 issue 调研时使用的完整
754 行 Python 文件。

希望请 layout / ISA 专家一起确认两件事：

1. 4×T reduce，尤其当前 `128xf32, G=4, T=32`，最佳物理 lowering 是什么？
2. 是否应直接支持 `num_groups=4, slots=8` 的 partial group-slot broadcast，去掉当前
   `group_store -> UB -> group_broadcast_load` round trip？

## 当前观察结论

在 PTOAS HEAD `0acf08e5d9cb` 上，用等价的最小 VMI IR 验证：

```text
load 128xbf16
  -> extf 128xf32
  -> group_reduce_maxf(num_groups=4, group_size=32)
```

layout assignment 为：

```text
128xbf16  deinterleaved=2
    | extf
128xf32   deinterleaved=4
    | group_reduce_maxf G=4
4xf32     group_slots(num_groups=4, slots=8)
```

当前 reduce lowering 没有 `vselr`。下面给出实际关键输入和输出，而不只列指令名。

最小复现可用当前 build tree 直接运行：

```bash
build-llvm21/tools/pto-test-opt/pto-test-opt \
  -vmi-lower-unified-to-legacy \
  -vmi-mask-granularity-assignment \
  -vmi-layout-assignment \
  -vmi-to-vpto repro.pto
```

其中核心 VMI 形态为：

```mlir
%x16 = pto.vmi.vload %src[%off]
  : !pto.ptr<bf16, ub> -> !pto.vmi.vreg<128xbf16>
%x32 = pto.vmi.vcvt %x16
  : !pto.vmi.vreg<128xbf16> -> !pto.vmi.vreg<128xf32>
%mask = pto.vmi.create_group_mask %c128
  {num_groups = 4, group_size = 32}
  : index -> !pto.vmi.mask<128xpred>
%amax = pto.vmi.vcmax %x32, %mask {group = 4, reassoc}
  : !pto.vmi.vreg<128xf32>, !pto.vmi.mask<128xpred>
  -> !pto.vmi.vreg<4xf32>
```

layout assignment 后，四个关键 value 分别是：

```text
%x16  : 128xbf16, deinterleaved=2
%x32  : 128xf32,  deinterleaved=4
%mask : 128xb32,  deinterleaved=4
%amax : 4xf32,    group_slots(num_groups=4, slots=8)
```

当前 `vmi-to-vpto` 的关键输出如下（省略常量和无关属性）：

```mlir
%x0 = pto.vlds %src[%off]
  : !pto.ptr<bf16, ub> -> !pto.vreg<128xbf16>

%x_even, %x_odd = pto.vdintlv %x0, %x0
  : !pto.vreg<128xbf16>, !pto.vreg<128xbf16>
  -> !pto.vreg<128xbf16>, !pto.vreg<128xbf16>

%f0 = pto.vcvt %x_even, %mask16 {part = "EVEN"}
  : !pto.vreg<128xbf16>, !pto.mask<b16> -> !pto.vreg<64xf32>
%f1 = pto.vcvt %x_odd, %mask16 {part = "EVEN"}
  : !pto.vreg<128xbf16>, !pto.mask<b16> -> !pto.vreg<64xf32>
%f2 = pto.vcvt %x_even, %mask16 {part = "ODD"}
  : !pto.vreg<128xbf16>, !pto.mask<b16> -> !pto.vreg<64xf32>
%f3 = pto.vcvt %x_odd, %mask16 {part = "ODD"}
  : !pto.vreg<128xbf16>, !pto.mask<b16> -> !pto.vreg<64xf32>

%m01 = pto.vmax %f0, %f1, %mask32
%m012 = pto.vmax %m01, %f2, %mask32
%m0123 = pto.vmax %m012, %f3, %mask32
%amax = pto.vcgmax %m0123, %mask32
```

因此这段 reduce 的实际关键指令计数是：

```text
1 x vdintlv
4 x vcvt (2 EVEN + 2 ODD)
3 x vmax
1 x vcgmax
0 x vselr
```

这里 `combineEquivalentMaskedParts` 先用 3 次 `vmax` 合并四个等价 layout
part，最后只发出一次 `vcgmax`。

`vselr` 实际来自后面的 4-slot broadcast：

```text
4xf32 in UB -> broadcast to 128xf32:
  vsldb(PAT_VL4) + 2 x vselr

4xbf16 in UB -> broadcast to 128xbf16:
  vsldb(PAT_VL4) + 1 x vselr
```

以 `4xf32 -> 128xf32` 为例，当前输出的核心数据流可以具体写成：

```mlir
%slots = pto.vsldb %slot_base, %zero, %zero, %pat_vl4
%idx0 = [0 x 32, 1 x 32]
%b0 = pto.vselr %slots, %idx0
%idx1 = [2 x 32, 3 x 32]
%b1 = pto.vselr %slots, %idx1
```

其中 `%b0/%b1` 是 `128xf32` contiguous value 的两个 physical parts；每个
group slot 被复制到对应的 32 个 logical lanes。

所以目前更准确的说法是：

> 4×T reduce 本身不生成 `vselr`；当前 compact scale reload/broadcast 会生成
> `vselr`。如果将来选择 contiguous reduce 方案，reduce 内部也可能主动使用
> `vselr` 来整理 VCG partial results。

## `per_block_cast_vmi.py` 中的 CCE/ASC 物理序列

脚本中保留了一条手写 ASC/CCE 实现，可以作为目标序列的直接参考。对
`bf16_math=f32`，amax 路径的关键代码是：

```python
for i in range(block_m):
    a0u, a1u = S.vintlv(zero_bf16, S.vld(x_ub[i, col]))
    amax0 = S.vmax(
        amax0,
        S.vabs(T.reinterpret(a0u, "float32x64"), m32),
        m32,
    )
    amax1 = S.vmax(
        amax1,
        S.vabs(T.reinterpret(a1u, "float32x64"), m32),
        m32,
    )

a0 = S.vcmax(raw0, m_low)
a1 = S.vcmax(raw0, m_high)
amax_vec0 = S.vsel(S.vdupv(a0, m32), S.vdupv(a1, m32), m_low)

a2 = S.vcmax(raw1, m_low)
a3 = S.vcmax(raw1, m_high)
amax_vec1 = S.vsel(S.vdupv(a2, m32), S.vdupv(a3, m32), m_low)
```

它明确采用“两条 f32 residue stream，各自用 low/high mask 做两次 `vcmax`”的
方式得到四个 amax，然后用 `vdupv + vsel` 把四个结果分发到对应 lanes。

reciprocal 计算完成后，脚本再把两个 f32 reciprocal vector 交织成 bf16
broadcast carrier，并执行量化与 FP8 pack store：

```python
_low, high = S.vdintlv(
    T.reinterpret(inv0, "uint16x128"),
    T.reinterpret(inv1, "uint16x128"),
)
sf_inv = T.reinterpret(high, "bfloat16x128")

q_bf16 = S.vmul(S.vld(x_ub[i, col]), sf_inv, m16)
q0u, q1u = S.vintlv(zero_bf16, q_bf16)
q0 = T.reinterpret(q0u, "float32x64")
q1 = T.reinterpret(q1u, "float32x64")
S.vsts(q_ub[i, col], S.vcvt(q0, T.float8_e4m3fn, m32),
       m32, dist="PK4_B32")
S.vsts(q_ub[i, col + 64], S.vcvt(q1, T.float8_e4m3fn, m32),
       m32, dist="PK4_B32")
```

两条路径的关键对应关系是：

| CCE/ASC 手写路径 | 当前 VMI/VPTO 表达 |
| --- | --- |
| `vintlv(zero_bf16, vld)` | load 后 assignment 为 `deinterleaved=2` |
| `vcmax(raw0/raw1, low/high)` | `group_reduce_maxf(G=4)` |
| `vsel` 分发 `a0/a1/a2/a3` | group-slot layout 与 broadcast lowering |
| `vdintlv(inv0, inv1)` | bf16 reciprocal carrier materialization |
| `vmul + vintlv + PK4_B32` | `vmul + vcvt + PK4_B32 store` |

注意：以上是 `per_block_cast_vmi.py` 中 ASC/CCE 分支的**源码级物理序列**，不是
本 issue 环境中重新生成的 Bisheng 汇编；当前没有运行 CCE compiler。也希望专家
确认这条手写序列是否仍是 `4×32` 的推荐目标，以及 VMI lowering 应更接近这条序列，
还是应采用下面讨论的 contiguous partial-fold 方案。

## Layout 速览

下面只画 dense value；reduce 结果使用单独的 `group_slots` layout。

### 1. contiguous

所有 logical lanes 按顺序连续存在：

```text
logical:  0  1  2  3  4  5  6  7 ...
physical: 0  1  2  3  4  5  6  7 ...
```

典型 lowering：普通 `vlds/vsts`，elementwise op 原位执行。

### 2. deinterleaved=F

所有 residue classes 都有语义，并拆成 F 个 physical parts：

```text
logical lane i:
  part = i % F
  lane = floor(i / F)

F=2:
  part0: 0 2 4 6 8 ...
  part1: 1 3 5 7 9 ...

F=4:
  part0: 0 4  8 12 ...
  part1: 1 5  9 13 ...
  part2: 2 6 10 14 ...
  part3: 3 7 11 15 ...
```

典型 lowering：`vldsx2 DINTLV_*`（满足直接 load 条件时）或寄存器
`vdintlv/vintlv` materialization。widen cast 也自然产生更多 parts，例如：

```text
bf16 deinterleaved=2 -> f32 deinterleaved=4
```

当前 grouped reduce 表按一个 32B VCG block 的倍数选 layout：

```text
1 block -> contiguous
2 blocks -> deinterleaved=2 或 block_deinterleaved=2
4 blocks -> deinterleaved=4 或 block_deinterleaved=4
```

### 3. contiguous + lane_stride=LS

只有一个 phase-zero stream 有语义，其他 lanes 是 holes：

```text
logical:  0 1 2 3 4 ...
physical: 0 _ 1 _ 2 _ 3 _ 4 ...   lane_stride=2
```

它和 `deinterleaved=2` 不同：

```text
deinterleaved=2: even/odd 两个 residue stream 都属于同一个 logical value
lane_stride=2:   只有一个 stream 有语义，空洞不是另一个 part
```

当前典型 lowering：

```text
load:      UNPK_B8 / UNPK_B16 / UNPK_B32 / UNPK4
store:     PK_B16 / PK_B32 / PK_B64 / PK4_B32
register:  vzunpack / vpack
cast:      phase-zero source通常只需 vcvt EVEN
```

因此 `lane_stride` 不能直接替代 4×T reduce 所需的完整
`deinterleaved=2/4` residue classes，但可能用于表达某些中间 partial slots。

### 4. block_deinterleaved=F

按 32B block 而不是逐元素 residue 拆分：

```text
32B blocks: B0 B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 ...
F=2 part0: B0 B2 B4 ...
F=2 part1: B1 B3 B5 ...
```

它适合 producer 已经按 32B block 分片的 group load，不应与逐元素
`deinterleaved=F` 混为一谈。

### 5. group_slots

group reduce 结果不是 dense vector：

```text
#pto.vmi.layout<num_groups=G, slots=8>
```

只有前 G 个 slot（或分 chunk 后的 active slots）有语义。当前 packed VCG reduce
使用 `slots=8`，即使 `G=4` 也仍是 partial packet：

```text
physical slots: [g0 g1 g2 g3 _ _ _ _ ...]
semantic lanes:  4
capacity:        8
```

## 4×32 f32 的当前 layout 路径

一个 f32 VCG block 是 8 lanes。每个 logical group 有 32 lanes，即 4 个 VCG
blocks，因此当前规则选择 `deinterleaved=4`：

```text
logical groups:
  G0: x[ 0.. 31]
  G1: x[32.. 63]
  G2: x[64.. 95]
  G3: x[96..127]

deinterleaved=4:
  P0 contains logical columns 0 mod 4
  P1 contains logical columns 1 mod 4
  P2 contains logical columns 2 mod 4
  P3 contains logical columns 3 mod 4

each Pi:
  8 lanes/group x 4 groups = 32 semantic f32 lanes
  physical register capacity = 64 f32 lanes
```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[128xbf16 contiguous intent] --> B[deinterleaved=2 bf16]
  B -->|extf| C[deinterleaved=4 f32]
  C --> D[combine 4 equivalent masked parts]
  D --> E[vcgmax]
  E --> F[4 group slots]
```

这个方案的优点是规则统一，cast/layout propagation 可以把 reduce pressure 传回
producer。需要专家确认的是：对于只有 32/64 个 active lanes 的 partial physical
parts，当前 `vdintlv + vcvt + combine + vcgmax` 是否已经是目标机器上的最佳方案。

## 候选方案 A：保留当前 deinterleaved reduce

继续使用：

```text
2 VCG blocks/group -> deinterleaved=2
4 VCG blocks/group -> deinterleaved=4
```

优点：

- 和现有 layout table、cast propagation、VCG lowering 一致。
- 当 producer 本来就是 deinterleaved，reduce 不需要额外 gather。
- `combineEquivalentMaskedParts` 可在 mask 相同的 max/add case 中先合并 parts，
  减少 VCG 指令数。

需要确认：

- partial physical part 的 `vdintlv` 复制输入方式是否是推荐用法。
- inactive half-register lanes 的定义和 mask 合同是否足够明确。
- 对 `128xf32 G=4`，4 次 `vcvt` + 3 次 `vmax` + 1 次 `vcgmax` 与其他方案的成本比较。

## 候选方案 B：contiguous VCG + partial-slot folding

不先做 deinterleave，而是在 contiguous 数据上直接 VCG。

以相关的 `128xf16, G=4, T=32` 为例，一个 f16 VCG block 是 16 lanes：

```text
vcgmax(contiguous input) first 8 result slots:

  [g0.lo, g0.hi, g1.lo, g1.hi, g2.lo, g2.hi, g3.lo, g3.hi]
```

然后将相邻 partial 两两合并：

```text
even = vselr(partial, [0,2,4,6,...])
odd  = vselr(partial, [1,3,5,7,...])
out  = vmax(even, odd, PAT_VL4)
```

或者先 `shift + vmax`，最后只做一次 compact `vselr`。这条路径会让 reduce 自身
出现 `vselr`，但可能省掉 deinterleave 和额外 VCG。

对实际 `128xf32, G=4, T=32`，每组有 4 个 VCG partial，需要 4-way slot fold；
希望专家建议最合适的 shuffle/shift/tree 组合，以及是否有更直接的 ISA pattern。

建议把它建模为新的 local lowering plan，而不是新的 public layout：

```text
ContiguousPackedPartialGroupReduce
```

并由 cost model 在以下情况选择：

- producer 已是 contiguous；
- deinterleaved parts 只有部分 physical lanes 有效；
- contiguous VCG + slot fold 比 materialize deinterleaved 更便宜。

## 候选方案 C：先解决 partial group-slot direct broadcast

当前 direct `group_broadcast` validation 要求：

```text
num_groups % slots == 0
```

因此 `G=4, slots=8` 会报：

```text
requires full source group-slot chunks
```

等价的 assigned VMI 会在 `vmi-to-vpto` 前被 gate 拒绝：

```mlir
%b = pto.vmi.group_broadcast %recip {num_groups = 4}
  : !pto.vmi.vreg<4xf32,
      #pto.vmi.layout<num_groups = 4, slots = 8>>
  -> !pto.vmi.vreg<128xf32, #pto.vmi.layout<contiguous>>
```

但 `group_broadcast_load` fallback 已能从 UB 加载 4 个 active slots，并通过
`vselr` 广播。也就是说，已有 index mapping 能力基本足够，当前只是 direct
group-slot source 被 full-packet gate 拦住。

当前 per-block 数据流：

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  R[4 reciprocal group slots] --> S[group_store to UB]
  S --> L[vsldb PAT_VL4]
  L --> V[vselr broadcast]
  V --> D[128-lane reciprocal]
```

建议支持：

```text
group_broadcast:
  source = group_slots(num_groups=4, slots=8)
  result = 128xf32 contiguous or 128xbf16 contiguous
```

直接 lowering 为：

```text
4xf32 slots  -> 2 x vselr -> 128xf32
4xbf16 slots -> 1 x vselr -> 128xbf16
```

目标数据流：

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  R[4 reciprocal group slots] --> V[vselr direct broadcast]
  V --> D[128-lane reciprocal]
```

这应当可以先独立落地，直接删除 `vsts/vsldb` round trip，并为后续 4×T reduce
cost-model 调优保留空间。

## 希望专家重点回答

1. 对 `128xf32, G=4, T=32`，当前 deinterleaved=4 路径是否合理？
2. contiguous VCG 后整理 4-way partial slots，推荐 `vselr`、shift，还是其他 ISA？
3. 对 `128xf16, G=4, T=32`，是否值得单独提供 contiguous 2-way partial fold？
4. partial deinterleaved physical parts 的 inactive-lane/mask 合同应如何定义？
5. 是否同意先放开 `G < slots` 的 direct group_broadcast，并复用现有
   `createMappedGroupSlotIndexVector` / `vselr` lowering？
6. 是否存在可以直接表达 4×T grouped max/add 的更合适硬件指令或惯用序列？

## 建议验收用例

- `128xbf16 -> 128xf32 -> group_reduce_maxf(G=4)`，检查 assigned layouts 和 VPTO。
- `128xf32 group_reduce_maxf(G=4) -> group_broadcast`，不经过 UB round trip。
- `128xbf16 group_reduce_maxf(G=4)` 或等价 `128xf16` 伴生 case。
- G=4 partial slots 的 add/max、direct broadcast、group_store。
- G=8 full packet 回归，确保 E2B/BRC fast path 不退化。
- 对比指令数与 simulator/NPU latency：deinterleaved plan vs contiguous partial-fold plan。

## #1026 [Bug] fence_scope<gm> emits pipe_barrier(PIPE_FIX) in a vector kernel, hanging the device after a TPUT

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1026
- Created: 2026-07-28T08:03:45Z
- Updated: 2026-07-29T09:26:24Z
- Closed: 2026-07-29T02:18:40Z

### Body

**Component:** `EmitC / Codegen (lib/PTO/Transforms/PTOToEmitC.cpp)`

**Git commit:** ptoas **0.52 and 0.53** (aarch64 release tarballs, sha256
`a64e7ee9753dde1bca0d4c71c0cb6950b4d1f8bdf1c39580b3af3d442bc3fe8b` and
`f096a4a102ae8d4a2461f094dd54f63919cb49be51f392d66ce58efd175510c6`)

> Checked against 0.53: the `fence_scope<gm>` lowering is **byte-identical** to 0.52 —
> diffing the emitted function body for a module containing only that op yields no
> difference. (0.53 does rework the DCCI helper into a generic
> `PTOAS__GLOBAL_TENSOR_DATA`; that part is fine and #995 stays fixed.)

**Target arch:** a2a3 · **PTO level:** level3 · **Host:** Linux aarch64

---

## Description

`pto.fence.barrier_all #pto.fence_scope<gm>` lowers to a four-instruction sequence that
includes `pipe_barrier(PIPE_FIX)`:

```cpp
pipe_barrier(PIPE_MTE2);
pipe_barrier(PIPE_MTE3);
pipe_barrier(PIPE_FIX);
dsb(DSB_DDR);
```

In a kernel declared `#pto.kernel_kind<vector>` the whole body is emitted inside
`#if defined(__DAV_VEC__)`, so that `pipe_barrier(PIPE_FIX)` executes on a vector core.
On its own that appears harmless. **But if the same kernel has executed a
`pto.comm.tput` earlier, the kernel never returns** — the scheduler reports no forward
progress and the device is force-reset.

We bisected the four instructions by emitting each one alone in place of the fence.
`PIPE_FIX` is the single lethal one:

| emitted in place of the fence | device result |
| ----------------------------- | ------------- |
| `pipe_barrier(PIPE_ALL)` | completes |
| `pipe_barrier(PIPE_MTE2)` | completes |
| `pipe_barrier(PIPE_MTE3)` | completes |
| **`pipe_barrier(PIPE_FIX)`** | **hangs** (507018, see logs) |
| `MTE2` + `MTE3` + `FIX` + `dsb` (the current lowering) | hangs |
| `PIPE_ALL` **then** `MTE2` + `MTE3` + `FIX` + `dsb` | hangs |

The last row matters: prepending a full `PIPE_ALL` drain does **not** rescue it, so this is
not about work still pending on the FIX pipe at that point.

Two further controls:

- The identical fence in a **single-device kernel with no `tput`** completes normally —
  same `__DAV_VEC__` guard, byte-identical four instructions. So `pipe_barrier(PIPE_FIX)`
  on a vector core is only lethal once a `tput` has run.
- Suppressing the neighbouring `pto.cmo.cacheinvalid` changes nothing — it is not an
  adjacency effect.

`#pto.fence_scope<all>` lowers identically to `<gm>`, and `<local_memory>` emits nothing,
so there is no spelling of this op that gives a GM fence without `PIPE_FIX`.

### Possible mechanism (speculation)

`PIPE_FIX` is the fixpipe, a cube-side unit that a vector core does not have. A plain
`pipe_barrier(PIPE_FIX)` there seems to be tolerated while nothing is outstanding, but a
`tput` apparently leaves something the vector core can never retire. This lines up with a
note in our own TPUT codegen: an MTE3-scoped barrier is not enough to drain a TPUT because
"its cross-rank DMA/atomic completion involves another pipe" — if that pipe is the fixpipe,
the barrier would wait forever.

## Reproduction (minimal)

Two ops are enough: one `pto.comm.tput`, then the fence. Full module (also attached as
`repro.pto`):

```mlir
module attributes {pto.target_arch = "a2a3"} {
  func.func @step(%arg0: !pto.ptr<f32>, %arg1: !pto.ptr<f32>, %arg2: !pto.ptr<f32>,
                  %arg3: !pto.ptr<i64>, %arg4: index)
      attributes {pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<vector>} {
  %c0_i64 = arith.constant 0 : i64
  %c64_index = arith.constant 64 : index
  %c1_index = arith.constant 1 : index
  %c0_index = arith.constant 0 : index
  %inp_view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg0, shape = [%arg4, %c64_index], strides = [%c64_index, %c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>}: !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32>
  %data_view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg2, shape = [%arg4, %c64_index], strides = [%c64_index, %c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>}: !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32>
  %stage = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c0_i64 valid_row = %c1_index valid_col = %c64_index : !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, dtype=f32, rows=1, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>
  %peer_pview = pto.partition_view %data_view, offsets = [%c0_index, %c0_index], sizes = [%c1_index, %c64_index] : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x64xf32>
  %local_pview = pto.partition_view %inp_view, offsets = [%c0_index, %c0_index], sizes = [%c1_index, %c64_index] : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x64xf32>
  pto.barrier <PIPE_ALL>
  pto.comm.tput(%peer_pview, %local_pview, buf(%stage) : !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x64xf32>, !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x64xf32>, !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, dtype=f32, rows=1, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>) {atomicType = #pto<atomic_type atomic_none>}
  pto.barrier <PIPE_ALL>
  pto.fence.barrier_all #pto.fence_scope<gm>
  return
  }
}
```

```bash
ptoas repro.pto -o repro.cpp --pto-level=level3   # compiles fine
```

**Scope of what this module verifies.** We confirmed it compiles under both 0.52 and 0.53
and that it emits the four-instruction fence shown below — that part is reproducible from
this file alone. The *device* hang was reproduced through our compiler's full flow, not by
running this `.pto` standalone: it has no HCCL window / rank context, so `pto.comm.tput`
would need that wiring to actually execute. If a runnable end-to-end case is more useful
than the IR, we can share the pypto reproducer script (single straight-line
`pld.tensor.put`, 2 ranks) — just ask.

On the device side, swapping only the final `pto.fence.barrier_all #pto.fence_scope<gm>`
for `pto.barrier <PIPE_ALL>` — everything else identical — turns the hang into a clean
completion. That is the one-line difference behind the table above.

## Expected behavior

`pto.fence.barrier_all #pto.fence_scope<gm>` is usable after a `pto.comm.tput` in a
`#pto.kernel_kind<vector>` kernel — it should drain the pipes and issue the DDR barrier
without waiting on a pipe the target core cannot retire.

Concretely, either:

1. do not emit `pipe_barrier(PIPE_FIX)` when the enclosing kernel kind is `vector` (use
   `PIPE_ALL`, or the MTE-only subset plus `dsb`); or
2. if the current lowering is intended and the op is simply not legal after a `tput`,
   please say so and reject it in the verifier — silently emitting code that hangs the
   device is the worst of the three outcomes.

Either resolution works for us; we mainly need to know which. Our compiler
(pypto) inserts this fence to implement the publish side of the data-before-signal
contract, so we currently have to fall back to a bare `pto.barrier <PIPE_ALL>` and lose
the `dsb(DSB_DDR)` the fence exists to provide.

## Actual behavior / error logs

The kernel never completes; the scheduler times out with no forward progress and the
runtime force-resets the device:

```
Aicpu kernel execute failed, device_id=7, stream_id=43, task_id=0
rtStreamSynchronizeWithTimeout execution failed, reason=aicpu exception
synchronize stream with timeout failed, runtime result = 507018
AICore error 507018: bounded device drain failed: 507015 (force reset will follow in finalize)

PTO2 runtime failed: orch_error_code=0 sched_error_code=100 runtime_status=-100
error detail: sched_error_code=100 SCHEDULER_TIMEOUT - the scheduler saw no forward
              progress within its timeout
PTO2 scheduler timeout sub_class=S1:running-stalled (detail=1)
              completed=0/1 running=1 ready=0 waiting=0 orch_done=1
              stuck_task_id=4294967296 stuck_core=26
```

Blast radius on our side: 26 of 38 distributed system tests fail and one hangs to the job
timeout; a 2-rank MoE model example also hangs (`TENSOR_WAIT_TIMEOUT`). All of them pass
with the fence replaced by `pto.barrier <PIPE_ALL>`.

---

### Generated C++ for reference

The fence body as emitted for the repro above (vector kernel):

```cpp
AICORE void step(...) {
  #if defined(__DAV_VEC__)
  ...
  pipe_barrier(PIPE_ALL);
  pto::comm::TPUT(v16, v19, v10);
  pipe_barrier(PIPE_ALL);
  pipe_barrier(PIPE_MTE2);   // ┐
  pipe_barrier(PIPE_MTE3);   // │ fence_scope<gm>
  pipe_barrier(PIPE_FIX);    // │ ← this one hangs
  dsb(DSB_DDR);              // ┘
  #endif // __DAV_VEC__
}
```

Note the emitted preamble also carries `#ifndef PIPE_FIX / #define PIPE_FIX PIPE_M`, so on
an arch without a fixpipe this barrier becomes `pipe_barrier(PIPE_M)` — a cube pipe — which
looks like the same class of problem.

## #1032 [Bug] [阻塞] pto.ldg/pto.stg outside pto.simt_entry pass verification but crash Bisheng

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1032
- Created: 2026-07-29T02:09:48Z
- Updated: 2026-08-05T03:09:15Z
- Closed: 2026-08-05T03:09:15Z

### Body

### Component

Passes / Transforms (lib/PTO/Transforms)

### Description

TileLang needs scalar GM accesses with data-cache bypass outside a SIMD/SIMT
region. It currently lowers those accesses to:

```mlir
pto.ldg ... l1cache(uncache)
pto.stg ... l1cache(uncache)
```

inside the enclosing `pto.aicore` function.

PTOAS accepts and verifies this IR, even though `PTOLdgOp` and `PTOStgOp`
derive from `PTO_SimtOp`. The VPTO backend then lowers them to
`llvm.hivm.ldg.*` and `llvm.hivm.stg.*` calls in the ordinary AICore function.

Bisheng crashes while compiling the generated device LLVM IR.

The same `pto.ldg/pto.stg` operations work when placed inside a function with
the `pto.simt_entry` attribute. PTOAS's existing
`simt-ldst-policy-core/kernel.pto` test compiles successfully.


### Reproduction (minimal)

```markdown
module attributes {
  pto.target_arch = "a5",
  pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<vector>
} {
  func.func @repro_aicore_scalar_ldg(
      %src: !pto.ptr<f32, gm>,
      %dst: !pto.ptr<f32, gm>
  ) attributes {pto.aicore} {
    %c0 = arith.constant 0 : index
    %value = pto.ldg %src[%c0]
        l1cache(uncache) l2cache(nmfv)
        : !pto.ptr<f32, gm> -> f32
    pto.stg %value, %dst[%c0]
        l1cache(uncache) l2cache(nmfv)
        : !pto.ptr<f32, gm>, f32
    return
  }
}


Compile with:


ptoas --pto-arch=a5 --pto-backend=vpto \
  repro_aicore_scalar_ldg.pto \
  -o repro_aicore_scalar_ldg.fatobj.o
```

### Expected behavior

1. Support scalar GM cache-bypass load/store in a `pto.aicore` function and
   lower them to instructions valid in that execution context; or
2. If `pto.ldg/pto.stg` are only legal inside `pto.simt_entry`, reject their
   use in other functions during PTO verification and provide a clear
   diagnostic.

For TileLang integration, a dedicated AICore scalar GM bypass operation would
be useful. Replacing these accesses with ordinary `pto.load/pto.store` would
lose the required data-cache bypass semantics.

### Actual behavior / error logs

```text
Error: device LLVM compilation failed
Command: bisheng --cce-aicore-arch=dav-c310-vec ...

*** stack smashing detected ***: terminated
bisheng: error: clang frontend command failed with exit code 134
clang version 15.0.5
```

## #1034 [Bug] PTODSL common_include_flags leaks PermissionError for an inaccessible driver include directory

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1034
- Created: 2026-07-29T02:35:25Z
- Updated: 2026-07-30T02:18:48Z
- Closed: 2026-07-30T02:18:48Z

### Body

### Component

Other — PTODSL runtime native toolchain (`ptodsl/ptodsl/_runtime/toolchain.py`)

### Description

`ptodsl._runtime.toolchain.common_include_flags()` raises an unhandled `PermissionError` when an include-path candidate has a non-searchable ancestor directory.

The immediate cause is `_append_include_flag()`:

```python
def _append_include_flag(flags: list[str], path: Path) -> None:
    if not path.is_dir():
        return
```

`Path.is_dir()` returns `False` for a missing path, but it may raise `OSError` (in this case `PermissionError`) when the path cannot be inspected. `_append_include_flag()` does not handle or contextualize that exception.

This was first observed with the default candidate `/usr/local/Ascend/driver/kernel/inc`, because `/usr/local/Ascend/driver/kernel` was installed as `root:root` with mode `0500`. That installation permission is an environment problem. The PTODSL issue reported here is narrower: native toolchain discovery terminates with a raw `pathlib` exception and provides no PTODSL/toolchain diagnostic.

### Reproduction (minimal)

The following reproducer is self-contained and does not require changing the system Ascend installation:

```bash
repro_dir=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$repro_dir/driver/kernel/inc"
chmod 000 "$repro_dir/driver/kernel"

ASCEND_DRIVER_PATH="$repro_dir/driver" python - <<'PY'
from ptodsl._runtime.toolchain import common_include_flags
common_include_flags()
PY

# Cleanup after the failing command.
chmod 700 "$repro_dir/driver/kernel"
rm -r "$repro_dir"
```

`ASCEND_HOME_PATH` must point to the normal CANN toolkit installation, as required by `common_include_flags()`.

### Expected behavior

Toolchain path discovery should handle a candidate that cannot be inspected in a defined way. For example, it may either:

1. skip the candidate consistently with the existing missing-directory behavior; or
2. raise a PTODSL-specific environment/toolchain error that names the inaccessible path and explains that search/read permission is required.

It should not expose an unhandled `PermissionError` from `pathlib` without context.

### Actual behavior / error logs

```text
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 2, in <module>
  File "ptodsl/ptodsl/_runtime/toolchain.py", line 124, in common_include_flags
    _append_include_flag(flags, driver / "kernel" / "inc")
  File "ptodsl/ptodsl/_runtime/toolchain.py", line 88, in _append_include_flag
    if not path.is_dir():
  File ".../python3.11/pathlib.py", line 1250, in is_dir
    return S_ISDIR(self.stat().st_mode)
  File ".../python3.11/pathlib.py", line 1013, in stat
    return os.stat(self, follow_symlinks=follow_symlinks)
PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: '<tmp>/driver/kernel/inc'
```

The original environment failure occurred before Bisheng invocation while PTODSL was constructing native compile flags. Correcting or bypassing the inaccessible driver path allowed native compilation and kernel launch to proceed, confirming that the reported exception belongs to toolchain path discovery rather than PTO IR generation.

N/A

## 环境信息

```text
PTOAS: 0.52
Host: Linux x86_64，kernel 6.8.0-136-generic
CANN: 9.1.0-beta.3
NPU: Ascend950PR
npu-smi: 25.7.rc1
ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7
```

## 问题描述

`pto.mte_l1_l0a_mx` 和 `pto.mte_l1_l0b_mx` 接收与 L0A/L0B 数据 Tile 关联的目标指针。

在 A5 上，MX Scale 地址应根据数据地址派生：

```text
scale_addr = data_addr >> 4
```

当前 VPTO LLVM lowering 仅将目标指针通过 `ptrtoint` 转换成整数，然后原样传递给 MX LOAD intrinsic，没有执行 `>> 4`。

当 L0A 数据地址为非零地址 `32768` 时，正确的 MX Scale 地址应该是：

```text
32768 >> 4 = 2048
```

但当前生成的 LLVM IR 仍然使用 `32768`，最终导致设备执行 LOAD2D 时访问 L0A/L0B 越界，并上报 `507015`。
## 最小复现 IR

```mlir
module attributes {pto.target_arch = "a5"} {
  module attributes {
    pto.backend = "vpto",
    pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<cube>,
    pto.target_arch = "a5"
  } {
    func.func @repro_mx_scale_l0_addr(
        %unused: !pto.ptr<f32, gm>
    ) attributes {
      pto.entry,
      pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<cube>
    } {
      %c0 = arith.constant 0 : i64
      %c32768 = arith.constant 32768 : i64
      %c16 = arith.constant 16 : i64
      %c64 = arith.constant 64 : i64

      %src = pto.castptr %c0
        : i64 -> !pto.ptr<!pto.f4E2M1x2, l1>
      %dst = pto.castptr %c32768
        : i64 -> !pto.ptr<!pto.f4E2M1x2, l0a>

      pto.mte_l1_l0a_mx
        %src, %dst, %c16, %c64, %c0, %c0
        : !pto.ptr<!pto.f4E2M1x2, l1>,
          !pto.ptr<!pto.f4E2M1x2, l0a>,
          i64, i64, i64, i64

      pto.barrier <PIPE_ALL>
      return
    }
  }
}
```

## 预期行为

CANN PTO 中的参考实现通过右移 4 位获得 MX Scale 地址：

```cpp
constexpr uint32_t SHIFT_MX_ADDR = 4;

template <typename T>
uint64_t GetScaleAddr(T *dst)
{
    uintptr_t addr = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(dst);
    return addr >> SHIFT_MX_ADDR;
}
```

因此，当 L0A 数据地址为 `32768` 时，预期生成：

```llvm
call void @llvm.hivm.LOAD.L1.TO.L0A.MX.2Dv2.v(
    i64 2048,
    ptr addrspace(2) null,
    ...
)
```

内核应正常执行，不应产生 AI Core 异常。

## 实际行为

当前生成的 LLVM IR 将 `32768` 原样传入 MX intrinsic：

```llvm
define void @repro_mx_scale_l0_addr_mix_aic(
    ptr addrspace(1) %unused
) {
  call void @llvm.hivm.LOAD.L1.TO.L0A.MX.2Dv2.v(
      i64 32768,
      ptr addrspace(2) null,
      i64 1103806595072,
      i64 65537
  )
  call void @llvm.hivm.BARRIER(i64 6)
  ret void
}
```

在 Ascend950PR 上运行后，`torch.npu.synchronize()` 报错：

```text
RuntimeError: npuSynchronizeDevice:
NPU function error: device error type 3, error code is 507015
```

Ascend Runtime debug plog 中的具体错误为：

```text
errcode:(263, 131)

The address for scalar to use is unaligned or out of bounds.
The GM address exceeds 48 bits, or the on-chip buffer address
exceeds the size of the buffer.
The address of the LOAD2D instruction to write L0A/L0B is out of bounds.

fault kernel_name=repro_mx_scale_l0_addr
ErrCode=507015, desc=[aicore exception]
```

## 初步根因定位

以下四个 lowering 实现都只执行了 `ptrtoint`：

```cpp
Value dstAddr =
    rewriter.create<LLVM::PtrToIntOp>(op.getLoc(), i64Ty, *dst);
```

随后直接将 `dstAddr` 传入 MX intrinsic，没有执行 `dstAddr >> 4`：

```text
lib/PTO/Transforms/VPTOLLVMEmitter.cpp
  LowerLoadCbufToCaMxOpPattern
  LowerLoadCbufToCbMxOpPattern

lib/PTO/Transforms/VPTOCANN900LLVMEmitter.cpp
  LowerLoadCbufToCaMxOpPattern
  LowerLoadCbufToCbMxOpPattern
```

## 独立设备复现脚本

```python
from ptodsl import pto


def ptr(address, space):
    return pto.castptr(
        pto.ui64(address),
        pto.ptr(pto.f4e2m1x2, space),
    )


@pto.jit(
    name="repro_mx_scale_l0_addr",
    kernel_kind="cube",
    target="a5",
    mode="explicit",
    insert_sync=False,
)
def kernel(unused: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm")):
    pto.mte_l1_l0a_mx(
        ptr(0, "mat"),
        ptr(32768, "left"),
        16,
        64,
    )
    pto.pipe_barrier(pto.Pipe.ALL)


def main():
    import torch
    import torch_npu

    compiled = kernel.compile()
    torch_npu.npu.set_compile_mode(jit_compile=False)
    torch.npu.set_device("npu:0")

    dummy = torch.empty(1, dtype=torch.float32, device="npu:0")
    stream = torch.npu.current_stream()._as_parameter_

    compiled[1, stream](dummy.data_ptr())
    torch.npu.synchronize()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## #1044 [Feature] [阻塞]提供面向运行时标量和 builtin vector 的公共浮点类型转换接口

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1044
- Created: 2026-07-29T07:39:33Z
- Updated: 2026-08-04T15:12:41Z
- Closed: 2026-08-04T15:12:41Z

### Body

### Summary

TileLang 等下游代码生成器需要对运行时浮点值进行类型转换，主要包括：

- 标量 `f16/bf16 -> f32` 扩精度转换；
- 标量 `f32 -> f16/bf16` 截精度转换；
- 对 `scalar.load(..., contiguous=N)` 返回的连续 builtin vector 执行相同转换。

PTODSL 目前已经包含内部辅助函数 `coerce_scalar_value_to_type`，但它不是公共 API，并且其浮点位宽处理尚未解析 `VectorType` 的元素类型。因此，下游项目只能直接导入 `mlir.dialects.arith` 和 `mlir.ir.VectorType`，自行生成 `arith.extf` 或 `arith.truncf`。

### Motivation / use case

下游生成代码直接导入 `mlir.*` 会引入不稳定的打包和兼容性依赖，TileLang PTO codegen 需要通过该接口完成 TIR 运行时浮点类型转换，从而避免依赖 PTOAS wheel 内部的 MLIR 模块布局

1. 下游项目依赖的是 PTOAS/MLIR 的内部实现细节，而不是 PTODSL 公共 API；
2. 后续 PTOAS wheel 可能调整内置 MLIR Python 包的目录结构，或者不再直接暴露这些模块；
3. 每个下游代码生成器都需要重复实现标量与 vector 的类型处理逻辑；
4. 直接操作 MLIR Value 容易绕过 PTODSL 的 `RuntimeValue`、`VecValue` 等表层封装。

当前 PTOAS wheel 虽然携带了 MLIR Python bindings，但不应将这一内部打包方式变成下游必须依赖的兼容性契约。

### Proposed API / behavior

在 `ptodsl.scalar` 中增加公共接口：

```python
from ptodsl import pto, scalar

wide_scalar = scalar.cast(f16_scalar, pto.f32)
wide_vector = scalar.cast(f16_vector, pto.f32)
```

建议接口语义如下：

- 接受运行时标量以及一维 builtin vector；
- 当输入是 vector、目标参数是标量 dtype 时，保留输入 vector 的 shape，只替换元素类型；
- 当目标参数是显式的 `pto.Vec(dtype, size)` 时，要求其 shape 与输入 vector 一致；
- 返回正常的 PTODSL 表层封装对象；
- 将 `arith.extf`、`arith.truncf` 和 `mlir.ir.VectorType` 的使用限制在 PTOAS 内部；
- 对标量到 vector 的隐式广播、vector shape 不匹配等情况给出清晰诊断。

### Additional context

初步提了一个PR，请参考：[#1043](https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/pull/1043)

## #1046 [Feature] Unify VMI PTODSL vadd and vadds interfaces

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1046
- Created: 2026-07-29T08:16:31Z
- Updated: 2026-08-07T08:03:39Z
- Closed: 2026-08-07T08:03:39Z

### Body

## Summary

Unify the VMI PTODSL vector-vector and vector-scalar addition APIs under `vadd`. PTODSL should select and emit the appropriate `vadd` or `vadds` VMI IR operation based on operand types. Adapt the TileLang VMI backend to the unified API as well.

## Motivation / use case

The VMI PTODSL API currently exposes separate `vadd`-class and `vadds`-class interfaces, requiring callers to choose an API based on whether the source operand is a vector or a scalar. This distinction can be inferred from operand types and should not be part of the user-facing DSL API.

A single `vadd` API makes PTODSL more consistent and reduces duplicated frontend handling. The TileLang VMI backend must follow the same convention so its generated PTODSL/VMI path remains compatible.

## Proposed API / behavior

- Expose one PTODSL API named `vadd` for both vector-vector and vector-scalar addition.
- When operands are vector/vector, emit the VMI `vadd` IR operation.
- When operands are vector/scalar, emit the VMI `vadds` IR operation.
- Validate unsupported or ambiguous operand type combinations with a clear diagnostic.
- Update the TileLang VMI backend to call/use the unified `vadd` interface.
- Remove or deprecate the separate user-facing `vadds` PTODSL API, with compatibility handling if required by existing callers.
- Add PTODSL and TileLang VMI backend regression tests covering both vector-vector and vector-scalar cases.

## Acceptance criteria

- Existing vector-vector addition continues to lower to `vadd`.
- Vector-scalar addition through the unified `vadd` interface lowers to `vadds`.
- TileLang VMI backend tests pass with the unified interface.
- Relevant documentation/examples no longer require users to choose between `vadd` and `vadds`.
