## #1111 [Bug] a5/level3: results regress v0.48 → v0.54 with zero arithmetic-opcode change — auto-sync flag pairs drop at v0.49, dcci scope goes OUT→ALL at v0.50

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1111
- Created: 2026-08-03T10:19:26Z
- Updated: 2026-08-06T01:13:46Z
- Closed: 2026-08-06T01:13:46Z

### Body

## Background

DeepSeek V4-Pro is a set of 35 runnable model/test cases in `hw-native-sys/pypto-lib`
(`models/deepseek/v4-pro/`) — 27 single-card, 8 multi-card/level3 — targeting Ascend 950 (a5).
A full build of the workload emits 3285 `.pto` files, 473 uniquely named. Throughout this
report, **"case"** means a runnable `.py` and **"kernel"** means one of the 473 `.pto` units.

We are trying to move that workload from PTOAS **v0.48** to **v0.54**, so that we can also take
current `pypto` main, whose relanded `InsertCommFence` pass emits `pto.cmo.cacheinvalid` /
`pto.fence.barrier_all` (ops v0.48 does not know — see the MoE compile failure below).

We ran a full 2×2 (two pypto revisions × two PTOAS binaries) to check whether this is PTOAS or
our own compiler. It is PTOAS.

**Reproduction environment** (the tree that reproduces; nothing reset to latest main):

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| pypto-lib | `fd91568` (branch `main`, on `origin/main`) |
| pypto | `a8ef572f` (branch `main`) — also tested at `a20e884f` (current main) |
| simpler | `8e00319e` (detached) **+ a local 31-line uncommitted patch** to `src/a5/platform/onboard/host/aicpu_topology_probe.cpp` (host CPU-topology probe fallback; identical in all four arms) |
| pto-isa | `83d01313` (detached) |
| ptoas | **v0.48** (working) vs **v0.54** (regressing) |
| CANN | 9.1.0-beta.3 |
| driver | 25.7.rc1.6 |
| host | Linux x86_64 |
| target | a5, `--pto-level=level3`, PYPTO memory planner |

Repro cases: `models/deepseek/v4-pro/{gate,hc_pre,prefill_compressor_ratio4,decode_attention_csa}.py`
at pypto-lib `fd91568`. All four, and every file on their import graphs, are committed and
unmodified in the tree that produced these results. (The one dirty file in that directory,
`moe.py`, is not on any of the four import graphs.)

**Diagnosis: `ptoas`** — the 2×2 holds pypto, pypto-lib, simpler, pto-isa, CANN, driver and
hardware fixed and moves only the PTOAS binary; 12/12 PASS on v0.48 and 0/12 on v0.54 in both
pypto arms.

---

## Description

On **four single-card cases** (of a 27-case single-card suite), moving PTOAS v0.48 → v0.54 takes
us from **12/12 PASS to 0/12 PASS** on real a5 hardware at `--pto-level=level3`, with **zero
arithmetic-opcode changes** anywhere in the generated code. The failures are memory-ordering /
cache-coherency shaped (NaN, wrong results, a VEC-UB-out-of-bounds device fault), not numerical.

These four cases were selected because they failed a first v0.54 smoke sweep. They are not a
random sample. Scope of the on-device result: a5, `--pto-level=level3`, PYPTO memory planner,
one card, one session. We did not test `--pto-level=level2` or other targets on device.

### Honest baseline: v0.48 is *mostly* stable, with two known exceptions that are ours

We want to disclose this up front rather than have you find it:

- **`prefill_attention_csa` already faults on v0.48**, at a 25–44 % rate (5/20 and 7/16 in our
  2026-07-31 sweep), with `errcode:(341) The address for VEC to access UB is out of bounds` —
  the *same* error code we report below for `decode_attention_csa` on v0.54. It is tracked as
  our own open bug, `hw-native-sys/pypto-lib#858`, with no root cause and no kernel-level fix.
  **We are not attributing #858 to PTOAS.**
- **`qkv_proj_rope` is flaky on v0.48** in this session: 3 of 7 runs FAIL on output `q`, at error ratios 0.90 %, 1.19 % and 1.26 % against a 0.50 % budget.

Neither of those two cases is in the 2×2 below. Excluding them, a 23-case single-card sweep on
v0.48 in this session is 22/23 PASS (the one failure is `qkv_proj_rope`).

### The PTOAS binary is the only variable we changed — full 2×2

Four single-card cases (`gate`, `hc_pre`, `prefill_compressor_ratio4`, `decode_attention_csa`),
3 repetitions each, **run strictly serially** (one JIT build in the tree at a time, so no build
contention), on real a5 hardware.

| | ptoas v0.48 | ptoas v0.54 |
|---|---|---|
| pypto `a8ef572f` | **12/12 PASS** | **0/12 PASS** |
| pypto `a20e884f` (current main) | **12/12 PASS** | **0/12 PASS** |

24 PASS on v0.48, 24 FAIL on v0.54, no crossover. (We are deliberately not quoting a p-value:
these are 4 cases × 3 repetitions, not 24 independent draws.)

The only variables between the two ptoas arms are `PTOAS_ROOT` and the matching
`LD_LIBRARY_PATH` needed to load that build's shared libraries. Nothing in pypto, pypto-lib,
simpler, pto-isa, CANN, the driver or the hardware changes.

**On the pypto axis.** The `.pto` that current-main pypto feeds to PTOAS differs from the older
pypto's by SSA/inline-counter renaming *plus* a set of newly emitted `arith.maxsi <offset>, 0`
partition-view offset clamps (30 across the `gate` case, 422 across `decode_attention_csa`'s 47
kernels; `a8ef572f` emits none). That is a real added op, not just renumbering. What matters
here is that it carries **no memory-ordering content**: both revisions' `.pto` for all four
failing cases contain **zero** `pto.fence.*` and **zero** `pto.cmo.*`. The pypto axis is inert
in outcome — both rows are 12/12 on v0.48 and 0/12 on v0.54.

### Per-case failures on v0.54 (3/3 reproducible each)

| Case | Failure |
|---|---|
| `decode_attention_csa` | `errcode:(341) The address for VEC to access UB is out of bounds` |
| `hc_pre` | output `comb` returns `NaN=64` of 128 elements |
| `gate` | output `weights` mismatches golden (3/3); `indices` also mismatches (2/3) |
| `prefill_compressor_ratio4` | output `cmp_kv` mismatches golden (this case has a **zero** error budget, `max_error_ratio=0.0`) |

The failures reproduce 3/3 in every v0.54 arm and are per-repetition identical across the two
pypto revisions. The corruption itself is **not** bit-deterministic:
`prefill_compressor_ratio4`'s error count varies 1793–1811 of 2097152 across repetitions, and
`gate` repetition 2 mismatches `weights` alone while repetitions 1 and 3 mismatch `indices` and
`weights` — the same pattern in both pypto arms. Run-to-run variation of this shape is what we
would expect from a memory-ordering change rather than a numerics change.

`decode_attention_csa` is our sharpest signal: it has a **20/20 clean** record on v0.48 from our
2026-07-31 sweep (at pypto-lib `d9b5fef`, a different pypto-lib revision from this report's
`fd91568`), and in this session at `fd91568` it was **6/6 PASS on v0.48** (3 reps × 2 pypto
arms) and **3/3 device-fault on v0.54**.

### Breadth (weaker evidence, included so you can bound the blast radius)

A single-repetition v0.54 sweep over 26 single-card cases, run in parallel rather than in the
serial harness, gives **11 PASS / 15 FAIL**, with **9 distinct cases** hitting `errcode:(341)`
(`decode_attention_csa`, `decode_attention_hca`, `decode_attention_swa`, `decode_indexer`,
`prefill_attention_csa`, `prefill_attention_hca`, `prefill_attention_swa`, `prefill_indexer`,
`qkv_proj_rope`). We do not treat this as a gate — one run per case, parallel builds, and two of
those cases are the known-flaky ones above — but it indicates the effect is not confined to the
four cases in the 2×2, and that 11 cases still pass on v0.54.

### The alternative reading we cannot rule out

It is possible that v0.54's sync/CMO scheduling is **legal** and is merely exposing a latent
memory-ordering bug in our kernels. We take that seriously precisely because
`errcode:(341)` is an error our workload already produces on v0.48 (pypto-lib#858, open,
unattributed). We are raising it with PTOAS because (i) the change is on your side of the
boundary, (ii) the flip is 12/12 → 0/12 with nothing else varying, and (iii) we cannot
distinguish "legal change" from "incorrect change" without knowing the intended CMO/fence
contract — which is ask (2) below either way.

What would distinguish the two readings: if the removed `set_flag`/`wait_flag` pairs at the sites
below are ones the new pass model can *prove* redundant, this is ours; if the pass is relying on
an ordering guarantee that the emitted code does not actually establish, it is yours. That is a
question about your dependence model that we cannot answer from the outside.

---

## Reproduction (minimal)

### 0. Standalone emission repro — 13 lines of PTO, no hardware, no corpus

Save as `min.pto`. This is the unmodified `.pto` our compiler emits for the
`prefill_swa_dummy_cmp_table` kernel of `models/deepseek/v4-pro/prefill_attention_swa.py` (693
bytes), chosen because it is the smallest kernel in the workload that still exhibits the change:

```mlir
module attributes {pto.target_arch = "a5"} {
  func.func @prefill_swa_dummy_cmp_table(%arg0: !pto.ptr<i32>) attributes {pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<vector>} {
  %c32_index = arith.constant 32 : index
  %c1_index = arith.constant 1 : index
  %c0_index = arith.constant 0 : index
  %cmp_block_table_dummy_inline548__ssa_v0_view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg0, shape = [%c32_index], strides = [%c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>}: !pto.tensor_view<?xi32>
  scf.for %dummy_blk_inline519__idx_v0 = %c0_index to %c32_index step %c1_index {
    %0 = arith.index_cast %c0_index : index to i32
    pto.store_scalar %0, %arg0[%dummy_blk_inline519__idx_v0] : !pto.ptr<i32>, i32
  }
  return
  }
}
```

```bash
ptoas min.pto -o min.cpp --enable-insert-sync --pto-level=level3 --pto-arch a5
```

(These are exactly the flags pypto uses in production — `_get_ptoas_flags` in
`pypto/python/pypto/backend/pto_backend.py`, plus the a5 handler's `--pto-arch a5`.)

Complete diff of the emitted C++ (v0.48 = 45 lines, v0.54 = 50 lines), rc=0 in both:

```diff
@@ -20,6 +20,11 @@
   }
 }
 
+template <typename Ptr>
+static AICORE inline void PTOAS__DCCI_SINGLE_CACHE_LINE(Ptr ptr) {
+  dcci((__gm__ void*)ptr, cache_line_t::SINGLE_CACHE_LINE);
+}
+
 AICORE void prefill_swa_dummy_cmp_table(__gm__ int32_t* v1) {
@@ -30,16 +35,16 @@
   set_vector_mask(-1, -1);
-  for (size_t v6 = (size_t) v2; v6 < ((size_t) v4); v6 += (size_t) v3) {
-    v1[v6] = v5;
+  for (int64_t i6 = v2; i6 < v4; i6 += v3) {
+    v1[i6] = v5;
   }
   pipe_barrier(PIPE_ALL);
-  dcci((__gm__ void*)0, ENTIRE_DATA_CACHE, CACHELINE_OUT);
+  dcci((__gm__ void*)0, cache_line_t::ENTIRE_DATA_CACHE);
   dsb((mem_dsb_t)0);
   #endif // __DAV_VEC__
 
   pipe_barrier(PIPE_ALL);
-  dcci((__gm__ void*)0, ENTIRE_DATA_CACHE, CACHELINE_OUT);
+  dcci((__gm__ void*)0, cache_line_t::ENTIRE_DATA_CACHE);

```

The `dcci` emission delta is **independent of `--pto-level` (level2, level3), `--pto-arch` (a3,
a5), and `--enable-insert-sync` (present or absent)** — verified on this kernel, all 8
combinations, rc=0 everywhere.

We picked a kernel from `prefill_attention_swa` rather than from one of the four failing cases
because the failing cases' `dcci`-bearing kernels are too large to inline: `route_sort` (`gate`)
is 24,236 B with a 373-line emitted diff and `kv_and_cache_write` (`decode_attention_csa`) is
16,348 B with a 133-line diff. The `dcci` rewrite is identical in all 33. We can attach any of
them on request.

### 1. Host-only bisect v0.48 → v0.54 — this is the most useful thing in the report

We downloaded the `ptoas-bin-x86_64.tar.gz` asset of every release v0.48…v0.54 and re-compiled
two representative kernels with each. **Neither change is a v0.54 change** — they land at
**v0.49** and **v0.50**:

| Release | `mix_x`: `set_flag` / `wait_flag` | `route_sort`: `dcci` call form |
|---|---|---|
| v0.48 | 17 / 17 | `dcci(ptr, ENTIRE_DATA_CACHE, CACHELINE_OUT)` (3-arg) |
| **v0.49** | **11 / 11** | 3-arg |
| **v0.50** | 11 / 11 | **`dcci(ptr, cache_line_t::SINGLE_CACHE_LINE)` (2-arg)** |
| v0.51 | 11 / 11 | 2-arg |
| v0.52 | 11 / 11 | 2-arg |
| v0.53 | 11 / 11 | 2-arg |
| v0.54 | 11 / 11 | 2-arg |

- `mix_x` is the kernel in the failing `hc_pre` case that loses flag pairs.
- `route_sort` is the kernel in the failing `gate` case that gains a `dcci` body call.

So the flag-pair reduction is introduced in **v0.49** and the `dcci` call-form change in
**v0.50**; v0.51–v0.54 are unchanged for both. If you want to reproduce our on-device result
with the smallest possible delta, **v0.49 and v0.50 are the releases to look at**, not v0.54.

Scope of this bisect, stated precisely: it is **two kernels**, chosen because they are the ones
implicated in two of our four failing cases. We did **not** re-run the full 473-kernel corpus at
every intermediate release, so we are not claiming per-release counts for the other 40
sync-changed / 32 `dcci`-changed kernels.

**Incidental finding on v0.50.** `csa_slots_build_valid_qk_plan.pto` (118 827 B, from
`decode_attention_csa`) **does not finish compiling on v0.50** — we killed it at 180 s, where
v0.48 takes 0.26 s and v0.54 takes 0.63 s. That is consistent with PTOAS#950, and it is why the
`dcci` column above is measured on `route_sort` rather than on that kernel. We mention it only as
confirmation that #950 was real and is fixed by v0.51+; it is not part of the regression we are
reporting.

We have **not** run a device bisect. Say the word and we will run the on-device 2×2 at v0.49 and
v0.50 and post the result.

### 2. Differential compile over the whole workload — no hardware needed

473 uniquely-named `.pto` kernels from the V4-Pro build output, compiled with each binary under
the flags above:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| kernels compiled OK on v0.48 | 473 / 473 |
| kernels compiled OK on v0.54 | 473 / 473 |
| kernels whose emitted C++ differs | 473 / 473 — but see note |
| **kernels with a `T*` opcode-count change** | **0 / 473** |
| kernels with a `set_flag` / `wait_flag` count change | 37 / 473 (29 fewer, 8 more) |
| kernels with a `pipe_barrier` / `dsb` count change | 10 / 473 (all 10 fewer — e.g. `dispatch_push` `dsb` 1 → 0, `dispatch_meta` `pipe_barrier` 6 → 5) |
| kernels containing a `dcci` call in the kernel body — **same 33 in both versions, 66 call sites each; every site changes from the 3-arg to the 2-arg form** | 33 / 473 |
| kernels gaining a dead, never-called `PTOAS__DCCI_SINGLE_CACHE_LINE` template preamble | 473 / 473 |

Note on the "473/473 differ" row: the reason it is 473 and not ~50 is the unconditional
`PTOAS__DCCI_SINGLE_CACHE_LINE` template preamble, which v0.54 emits into every file and calls in
none of them (0 call sites across all 473). The substantive deltas are the rows below it.

Note for anyone re-deriving the `dcci` numbers: a raw `grep -c dcci` shows a delta on 473/473 for
that same reason. **No kernel gains or loses a real `dcci` call site** — `grep -h 'dcci((__gm__
void\*)0' out48/*.cpp | sort | uniq -c` gives 66 × the 3-arg form, and the same command on
`out54` gives 66 × the 2-arg form, over an identical set of 33 files.

Method for the arithmetic row: for each of the 473 kernels we counted every `T*` tile intrinsic
appearing in either output — **52 distinct opcodes**, including `TMATMUL`, `TMATMUL_ACC`,
`TMULS`, `TADDS`, `TROWSUM`, `TROWEXPANDMUL`, `TSQRT`, `TSORT32`, `TMRGSORT` — after stripping
comments and `[[pto::last_use(...)]]` attributes. Per-kernel opcode multisets are identical in
473/473. **Caveat:** this compares opcode *counts*, not instruction order, operands, tile shapes
or dtypes. It rules out a numerics *rewrite*; it does not rule out a reordering. The remaining
diffs are confined to `set_flag`/`wait_flag`, `pipe_barrier`/`dsb`, and `dcci`.

### 3. The `dcci` change, stated precisely

```c
// ptoas v0.48 — lines 1546 / 1551 of the emitted C++ for csa_slots_build_valid_qk_plan.pto (118,827 B)
dcci((__gm__ void*)0, ENTIRE_DATA_CACHE, CACHELINE_OUT);

// ptoas v0.54 — lines 2369 / 2374 of the same kernel
dcci((__gm__ void*)0, cache_line_t::ENTIRE_DATA_CACHE);
```

Per CANN 9.1.0-beta.3, `tools/bisheng_compiler/lib/clang/15.0.5/include/`:

- `cce_aicore_intrinsics.h`, `cache_line_t` (lines 285–290): `SINGLE_CACHE_LINE = 0`, `ENTIRE_DATA_CACHE = 1`
- `cce_aicore_intrinsics.h`, `dcci_dst_t` (lines 299–310): `CACHELINE_ALL = 0`, `CACHELINE_OUT = 2`
  (`CACHELINE_UB` is `#if`-excluded when `__NPU_ARCH__` is 3510 **or** 3801; `ccec -dM -E
  --cce-aicore-arch=dav-c310-vec` predefines `__NPU_ARCH__ 3510`, i.e. a5)
- `__clang_cce_simt_dav3510_intrinsic.h:70`:
  `dcci(__gm__ void *dst, uint64_t entire, uint64_t type = 0)` — **the 2-argument form defaults
  `type = 0 = CACHELINE_ALL`.**

Confirmed in the device object: compiling the three spellings with
`ccec -c -O3 -x cce -std=c++17 --cce-aicore-only --cce-aicore-arch=dav-c310-vec` and dumping
`.text`, the 3-arg `CACHELINE_OUT` form encodes as `02002e40`, the 3-arg `CACHELINE_ALL` form as
`00002e40`, and the 2-arg form as `00002e40` — byte-identical to `CACHELINE_ALL`.

**So the invalidate scope went from `OUT` to `ALL`, i.e. it got *wider*, not narrower.** We are
therefore explicitly **not** claiming this alone explains the failures. We flag it because it is
an unannounced semantic change at 66 call sites across 33 of the 473 kernels, and we would like
to know whether it was intended. See the mechanism ranking below.

Both versions' emitted C++ compiles cleanly for the device. We did not device-compile all 473;
we device-compiled `csa_slots_build_valid_qk_plan` and the minimal kernel above from both trees,
rc=0 in all four, with the full production flag set:

```bash
ccec -c -O3 -x cce -std=c++17 --cce-aicore-only --cce-aicore-arch=dav-c310-vec \
  -mllvm -cce-aicore-stack-size=0x8000 -mllvm -cce-aicore-function-stack-size=0x8000 \
  -mllvm -cce-aicore-record-overflow=false -mllvm -cce-aicore-addr-transform \
  -mllvm -cce-aicore-dcci-insert-for-scalar=false -mllvm -cce-vf-aa-between-iters=true \
  -DMEMORY_BASE -I<pto-isa>/include -I<pto-isa>/include/pto -I<pypto>/runtime/simpler_setup/incore
```

(The bare `ccec -c -O3 -x cce ...` line without those includes fails on
`'pto/pto-inst.hpp' file not found` — please use the full command.) Note
`-mllvm -cce-aicore-dcci-insert-for-scalar=false` is in our production set, which is directly
relevant to the `dcci` story: we rely on PTOAS, not the backend, to place these.

### 4. Correlation with the observed failures — and the counter-examples

All four failing cases own at least one changed kernel:

| Failing case | `dcci`-form-changed kernels it owns | Flag/barrier-changed kernels it owns |
|---|---|---|
| `gate` | `route_sort` | — |
| `decode_attention_csa` | `csa_slots_build_valid_qk_plan`, `kv_and_cache_write` | `mix_x` 17→11, `rmsnorm_rope_cache_write` 41→40, `rmsnorm_rope` 22→21, `weights_proj_reduce` 13→3 |
| `hc_pre` | — | `mix_x` 17→11 (six fewer flag pairs) |
| `prefill_compressor_ratio4` | — | `prefill_c4_rmsnorm_rope` 26→25 |

**Counter-examples exist in both directions, and we would rather show them than have you find
them.** `decode_sparse_attn` owns `csa_slots_build_valid_qk_plan` — a `dcci`-changed kernel — and
**passes** on v0.54. `qkv_proj_rope` **fails** on v0.54 with no `dcci` change and no flag/barrier
change at all (it is also 4/8 flaky on v0.48, so we weight it lightly). We present this table as
a lead worth checking, not as a strong correlation and certainly not as a proven root cause.

### 5. Which mechanism we would look at first

We think the **sync-scheduling change is the stronger candidate**, and we would rank it above the
`dcci` change:

1. **Auto-sync flag scheduling, landing at v0.49.** `hc_pre` fails with `NaN=64` and its `mix_x`
   kernel has *no* `dcci` change of any kind — its only substantive delta is six fewer
   `set_flag`/`wait_flag` pairs (17→11), and that delta lands at v0.49. So `dcci` cannot explain
   at least one of the four failures, while a sync-scheduling change can explain all four.
   `weights_proj_reduce` 13→3 in `decode_attention_csa` is the largest single reduction.
2. **The `dcci` destination-scope change, landing at v0.50.** Ranked second precisely because
   `OUT` → `ALL` is a *widening*, which is a weak story for stale data. We still want to know if
   it was deliberate.

We do not name a specific PR: we checked the obvious candidates and the merge dates do not line
up. #953 ("Remove automatic memory consistency pass", merged 2026-07-17) is in v0.50…v0.51;
#1001, #951, #1007 and #1011 all merged 2026-07-27/28, i.e. v0.52 and v0.53. Our bisect puts
both emission changes at **v0.49 and v0.50**, before all of those. You will know your own history
better than we can reconstruct it from tag dates.

### 6. Why we cannot simply stay on v0.48, and why the contract question matters

Current-main pypto's relanded `InsertCommFence` emits ops v0.48 cannot parse. The multi-card MoE
build on v0.48 fails outright:

```text
Failed to compile function 'dispatch_push': ptoas compilation failed:
  loc(".../ptoas/dispatch_push.pto":69:9): error: custom op 'pto.cmo.cacheinvalid' is unknown
Error: Failed to parse MLIR.
```

— for five functions (`combine`, `combine_wait`, `dispatch_meta`, `dispatch_push`,
`dispatch_wait`). So once we take current pypto, staying on v0.48 is not an option for us.

That same log also shows `InsertCommFence` **does** fire on the distributed/publish path. It does
not fire for our four single-card cases. `IsPublishingWrite`
(`pypto@a20e884f:src/ir/transforms/utils/op_predicates.cpp:77`) fires only on `pld.*` remote
writes; on a `tile.store` / `tensor.write` / `pld.tile.get` / `pld.tensor.get` whose destination
is a `DistributedTensorType`; or on a conservative fallback for unregistered ops, i.e. user
function calls. These four cases are single-core and non-distributed, so no DistributedTensor
trigger applies, and there are **0 `func.call` across all 473 `.pto`**, so the fallback is dead
too. Empirically: the `.pto` emitted by `a20e884f` for all four failing cases contains **zero**
`pto.fence.*` and **zero** `pto.cmo.*`. PTOAS no longer inserts on this path, and pypto does not
either.

(Correction to a claim we nearly made: `pl.submit` is unused anywhere in this workload, but
`decode_attention_csa` *does* enter one `pl.manual_scope`, via
`decode_sparse_attn.sparse_attn` at `decode_sparse_attn.py:487`. It still emits no fence and no
CMO. Corroborating this: the four cases in the workload that use `pl.manual_scope` —
`decode_sparse_attn{,_hca,_swa}`, `prefill_sparse_attn` — all **pass** on v0.54.)

### 7. Device reproduction (needs a5)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hw-native-sys/pypto-lib && git -C pypto-lib checkout fd91568
git clone https://github.com/hw-native-sys/pypto     && git -C pypto     checkout a8ef572f
git -C pypto submodule update --init runtime          # simpler 8e00319e
# CANN 9.1.0-beta.3 sourced; PYTHONPATH=<pypto>/python:<pypto>/runtime/python:<pypto-lib>

export PTOAS_ROOT=/path/to/ptoas-v0.48        # dir containing ./ptoas (or ./bin/ptoas)
cd pypto-lib/models/deepseek/v4-pro
for c in gate hc_pre prefill_compressor_ratio4 decode_attention_csa; do
  for i in 1 2 3; do python $c.py -p a5 -d 0; done    # expect 12/12 PASS
done

export PTOAS_ROOT=/path/to/ptoas-v0.54/bin
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/path/to/ptoas-v0.54/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
# repeat the same loop                                 # observed 0/12
```

Run the loop **serially** — one JIT build in the tree at a time. Note that
`pypto/toolchain/versions.env` is CI-only and is never consulted at runtime: pypto resolves the
binary purely from `PTOAS_ROOT` (`$PTOAS_ROOT/ptoas`, falling back to `$PTOAS_ROOT/bin/ptoas` for
the v0.51+ layout) and never probes `--version`. Swapping `versions.env` will change nothing.

The 473-kernel `.pto` corpus is generated build output and is not committed anywhere. To
regenerate it, run each case once under the setup above — every run leaves its kernels in
`build_output/_jit_<case>_<timestamp>/ptoas/*.pto`, and `run_jit(..., compile_only=True)` in
`golden/runner.py` gets you the `.pto` with no device. We have the 473-file corpus and all
emitted-C++ trees (v0.48/v0.49/v0.50/v0.54) archived; say the word and we will attach the tarball
to this issue via the web UI (`gh issue create` cannot upload).

---

## Expected behavior

For a workload whose arithmetic opcodes are unchanged, moving v0.48 → v0.54 should not change
results on device. Concretely, either:

1. the `dcci` destination-cache scope emitted for these kernels should be preserved, or the
   change from `CACHELINE_OUT` to the 2-argument (`CACHELINE_ALL`) form should be documented as
   intentional; and
2. if the auto-sync model legitimately proves those `set_flag`/`wait_flag` pairs redundant, and
   the CMO/fence contract has intentionally moved to the producer, that contract should be
   documented so pypto can emit the equivalent — specifically **what a frontend must now emit for
   non-distributed, single-core kernels**, not only for the cross-rank publish/wait case.

### What would help us most (three bounded asks)

1. **Was the `dcci` 3-arg → 2-arg change (v0.50) intentional?** One-line answer is enough; if
   yes, what should a producer emit to get `CACHELINE_OUT` semantics back.
2. **Was the auto-sync flag-pair reduction at v0.49 (e.g. `mix_x` 17 → 11, `weights_proj_reduce`
   13 → 3) intentional, and on what dependence model?** This is the one we cannot resolve
   ourselves, and it is what decides whether the latent-bug reading above is the right one.
3. **Tell us which on-device bisect point you want** and we will run the same serial 2×2 there.
   Our host bisect says the emission changes are at v0.49 and v0.50; v0.49 and v0.50 on device
   are the two runs we would do first unless you prefer others.

We have **not** tested **v0.55** (released 2026-08-03); this report is v0.48 vs v0.54. If you
want v0.55 data, say so and we will run the same 2×2 on it.

## #1117 [Bug] [PTODSL] [阻塞] FP32 标量 lowering 未经 fastmath 请求收缩 FMA，且 divf 存在 1 ULP 差异

- State: open
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1117
- Created: 2026-08-04T02:07:27Z
- Updated: 2026-08-04T16:24:01Z
- Closed: 

### Body

### Component

Python bindings (python/)

### Description

SIMT FP32 标量算术存在两类精度语义差异：

1. PTODSL 生成独立的 `arith.mulf` 和 `arith.addf`，且没有设置
   `fastmath`/`contract`，但最终运行结果与融合的 `fmaf` 完全一致。
2. SIMT 标量 `arith.divf` 与 PyTorch NPU FP32 除法存在约 1 ULP 差异，
   当前也没有类似 Tile `tdiv` 的 high-precision 标量接口可供选择。

### Reproduction (minimal)

```markdown
import ctypes

import torch
import torch_npu
from ptodsl import pto


N = 256

torch.npu.config.allow_internal_format = False
torch_npu.npu.set_compile_mode(jit_compile=False)
torch.npu.set_device("npu:0")


@pto.simt(max_threads=N)
def div_simt(
    lhs: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    rhs: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    dst: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
):
    tid = pto.get_tid_x()
    pto.stg(pto.ldg(lhs, tid) / pto.ldg(rhs, tid), dst, tid)


@pto.jit(
    name="simt_div_probe",
    kernel_kind="vector",
    target="a5",
    backend="vpto",
    mode="explicit",
)
def div_kernel(
    lhs: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    rhs: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    dst: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
):
    div_simt[N, 1, 1](lhs, rhs, dst)


@pto.simt(max_threads=N)
def muladd_simt(
    a: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    b: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    c: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    dst: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
):
    tid = pto.get_tid_x()
    pto.stg(
        pto.ldg(c, tid) + pto.ldg(a, tid) * pto.ldg(b, tid),
        dst,
        tid,
    )


@pto.jit(
    name="simt_muladd_probe",
    kernel_kind="vector",
    target="a5",
    backend="vpto",
    mode="explicit",
)
def muladd_kernel(
    a: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    b: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    c: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
    dst: pto.ptr(pto.f32, "gm"),
):
    muladd_simt[N, 1, 1](a, b, c, dst)


def mismatch_count(actual, expected):
    return int(
        (actual.view(torch.int32) != expected.view(torch.int32)).sum()
    )


stream = torch.npu.current_stream()._as_parameter_

# divf
torch.manual_seed(20260803)

lhs_host = torch.rand(N, dtype=torch.float32) * 2
rhs_host = torch.rand(N, dtype=torch.float32) * 128 + 0.25

lhs = lhs_host.to("npu:0")
rhs = rhs_host.to("npu:0")
div_output = torch.empty_like(lhs)

compiled_div = div_kernel.compile()
compiled_div[1, stream](
    lhs.data_ptr(),
    rhs.data_ptr(),
    div_output.data_ptr(),
)
torch.npu.synchronize()

actual_div = div_output.cpu()
expected_div = (lhs / rhs).cpu()

print(
    "div mismatch:",
    mismatch_count(actual_div, expected_div),
    "/",
    N,
)
print(
    "div max abs:",
    float((actual_div - expected_div).abs().max()),
)

# mulf + addf
torch.manual_seed(20260803)

a_host = torch.randn(N, dtype=torch.float32)
b_host = torch.randn(N, dtype=torch.float32)
c_host = torch.randn(N, dtype=torch.float32)

a = a_host.to("npu:0")
b = b_host.to("npu:0")
c = c_host.to("npu:0")
muladd_output = torch.empty_like(a)

compiled_muladd = muladd_kernel.compile()
compiled_muladd[1, stream](
    a.data_ptr(),
    b.data_ptr(),
    c.data_ptr(),
    muladd_output.data_ptr(),
)
torch.npu.synchronize()

actual_muladd = muladd_output.cpu()
separate_muladd = (c + a * b).cpu()

libm = ctypes.CDLL("libm.so.6")
fmaf = libm.fmaf
fmaf.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_float,
    ctypes.c_float,
    ctypes.c_float,
]
fmaf.restype = ctypes.c_float

fused_muladd = torch.tensor(
    [
        fmaf(float(x), float(y), float(z))
        for x, y, z in zip(a_host, b_host, c_host)
    ],
    dtype=torch.float32,
)

print(
    "mul+add vs separate mismatch:",
    mismatch_count(actual_muladd, separate_muladd),
    "/",
    N,
)
print(
    "mul+add vs fmaf mismatch:",
    mismatch_count(actual_muladd, fused_muladd),
    "/",
    N,
)

# 查看 PTODSL 生成的 MLIR
mlir_text = muladd_kernel.compile().mlir_text()
for line in mlir_text.splitlines():
    if "mulf" in line or "addf" in line or "fastmath" in line:
        print(line)
```

### Expected behavior

1. 当 MLIR 中只有独立的 arith.mulf 和 arith.addf，且没有fastmath<contract> 时，后端应保留两次独立舍入，不应自动收缩为 FMA。
2. 如果 PTOAS 设计上允许默认收缩，应提供显式控制开关，并明确记录数值语义。
3. SIMT FP32 标量除法应提供正确舍入或 high-precision 模式，类似 Tile tdiv(..., div_precision=...) 的能力。
4. 应增加 A5 VPTO 端到端运行测试，逐位验证：
  - 独立 mulf + addf
  - 显式 pto.fma
  - 标量 arith.divf
  - high-precision 标量除法

### Actual behavior / error logs

```text
div mismatch: 22 / 256
div max abs: 2.9802322387695312e-08

mul+add vs separate mismatch: 61 / 256
mul+add vs fmaf mismatch: 0 / 256


%7 = arith.mulf %4, %6 : f32
%8 = arith.addf %2, %7 : f32
```

## #1118 [Pass Bug] level2 insert-sync guards only the first multi_tile_get of an iteration; a second co-live slot is left unsynchronized

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1118
- Created: 2026-08-04T02:33:47Z
- Updated: 2026-08-05T09:21:13Z
- Closed: 2026-08-05T09:21:13Z

### Body

## Summary

At `--pto-level=level2 --enable-insert-sync`, when a loop body performs **two**
`pto.multi_tile_get` on the same `!pto.multi_tile_buf` region, ptoas emits the
per-slot dynamic WAR pair (`wait_flag`/`set_flag` on a derived `event_t`) for the
**first** access only. The second slot's `TLOAD` is emitted with **no preceding
`wait_flag` at all**, so the next iteration's write into that slot races the
current iteration's read of it.

The result is a silently wrong kernel on device — not a missed optimization.

Related to but distinct from #1106 (that one is a level3 address-folding issue;
this one is a level2 sync-derivation gap).

## Environment

- ptoas **v0.54** (aarch64), `--enable-insert-sync --pto-level=level2 --pto-arch a3`
- Device: Ascend a2a3
- `--enable-graph-sync-solver` behaves the same.

## Reproducer

Input `.pto` (trimmed — one region, two gets per iteration, both slot indices
affine in the loop variable):

```mlir
%ub_mb = pto.alloc_multi_tile valid_row = %c64_index valid_col = %c64_index
       : !pto.multi_tile_buf<!pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, dtype=f32, rows=64, cols=64,
                                           v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major,
                                           slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>, count=2>
scf.for %i = %c0_index to %c4_index step %c1_index {
  %0  = arith.remsi %i, %c2_index : index                 // i % 2
  %lo = pto.multi_tile_get %ub_mb[%0]  : ... -> !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, ...>
  pto.tload ins(%a_view ...) outs(%lo : ...)
  %3  = arith.addi %i, %c1_index : index
  %4  = arith.remsi %3, %c2_index : index                 // (i + 1) % 2
  %hi = pto.multi_tile_get %ub_mb[%4]  : ... -> !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, ...>
  pto.tload ins(%b_view ...) outs(%hi : ...)
  %s  = pto.tadd ins(%lo, %hi : ...) outs(%s : ...)       // both slots read here
  pto.tstore ins(%s ...) outs(%out_view ...)
}
```

## Emitted code (v0.54)

```cpp
// prologue — BOTH event ids are primed, so the region's slot count is understood
set_flag(PIPE_V, PIPE_MTE2, EVENT_ID0);
set_flag(PIPE_V, PIPE_MTE2, EVENT_ID1);

for (int64_t i11 = v8; i11 < v5; i11 += v6) {
  int64_t v12 = i11 % v4;
  uint64_t v14 = (uint64_t)(v12 == v6 ? v9 : v8);
  TASSIGN(v13, v14);                              // lo -> slot i % 2

  int64_t  v20 = (int64_t)((uint64_t)v12 % (uint64_t)v4) == v6 ? v6 : v8;
  event_t  v21 = (event_t) v20;                   // dynamic id derived from lo's slot
  wait_flag(PIPE_V, PIPE_MTE2, v21);              // <-- guards lo
  TLOAD(v13, v19);

  uint64_t v23 = (uint64_t)((int64_t)((uint64_t)i11 + (uint64_t)v6) % v4 == v6 ? v9 : v8);
  TASSIGN(v22, v23);                              // hi -> slot (i + 1) % 2
  TLOAD(v22, v26);                                // <-- NO wait_flag before this load

  set_flag(PIPE_MTE2, PIPE_V, EVENT_ID0);
  wait_flag(PIPE_MTE2, PIPE_V, EVENT_ID0);
  TADD(v27, v13, v22);                            // reads BOTH slots

  event_t v29 = (event_t) v20;
  set_flag(PIPE_V, PIPE_MTE2, v29);               // <-- releases lo's slot only
  ...
}
```

`EVENT_ID1` is primed in the prologue and then never waited on or set inside the
loop: only one of the two slots is ever guarded.

## Observed failure

`out = a + b` over 4 row-blocks of `[64, 64]` fp32, with distinct per-element
inputs. Expected `out[k] = a[k] + b[k]`; measured

```
out[k] = a[block i+1][k] + a[block i][k]
```

i.e. iteration *i+1*'s `lo` load into slot 1 landed before iteration *i*'s `TADD`
had read slot 1 as `hi`. Exactly the missing WAR edge.

## What does work

- **One `multi_tile_get` per iteration** (the ordinary ping-pong) is guarded
  correctly — dynamic `wait_flag`/`set_flag` pair present, numerically correct on
  device. This is the shape we ship.
- **Straight-line code** with two constant slots: no loop, no cross-iteration
  reuse, correct.
- An **Acc/L0C** region with two co-live slots happens to be correct, but not via
  per-slot ids — ptoas falls back to a single static `wait_flag(PIPE_FIX, PIPE_M,
  EVENT_ID0)` placed after both drains, which serializes conservatively.

## Expected behaviour

Every `multi_tile_get` of a region in an iteration should receive its own
per-slot WAR guard (or, failing that, a conservative guard) — never no guard at
all.

## Impact on PyPTO

PyPTO now **refuses** to lower a slotted allocation with two slots live inside one
loop body under `memory_planner=PTOAS`, and points the author at the PyPTO memory
planner instead. We would like to lift that restriction once this is fixed; on our
side it is a single condition in `PTOCodegen::PlanMultiBufferRegions`, with no
user-facing API change.


---

## #1120 [Bug] [PTODSL] [阻塞] PTOAS/PTODSL 适配 PIPE_MTE1 不在白名单里

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1120
- Created: 2026-08-04T04:05:59Z
- Updated: 2026-08-04T05:41:01Z
- Closed: 2026-08-04T05:41:01Z

### Body

### Component

PTO Dialect / ODS (include/PTO/IR)

### Description

## 问题究竟在哪
### 核心结论：
同步逻辑本身正确，问题是 TileLang、PTODSL、PTOAS 三层对 mode 4 同步能力的定义不一致。

### 1. 同步拓扑没有问题
PTO 与 AscendC 的代码已经逐项对比：
Cube set  PIPE_MTE1(p / p+16)
    ↔ Vector wait PIPE_MTE3(p)

Vector set PIPE_MTE3(p+2)
    ↔ Cube wait PIPE_MTE1(p+2 / p+18)
pipe、event、+16 sid 映射、执行顺序均一致，也符合 CANN A5 的 1 Cube + 2 Vector 协议。
因此不应该修改：
barrier.cc 调度逻辑
pipe 端点
event ID
+16 映射
prologue/epilogue
set/wait 顺序
### 2. 第一处问题：白名单能力缺口
当前源码存在三层不一致：
TileLang mode 4 codegen 不允许 PIPE_MTE1
PTOAS A5 SyncSetOp 只允许 PIPE_FIX/PIPE_MTE3
CANN/Bisheng 实际支持：
set_intra_block(PIPE_MTE1, event_id);
所以这是 verifier/API 没覆盖真实硬件能力，不是硬件不支持。
### 3. 第二处问题：动态 event 类型没有转换
仅放开白名单后，动态调用仍会失败：
expects Value, got RuntimeValue
TileLang 当前直接生成：
_tl_pto_ops.sync_wait(pipe, dynamic_event)
但 dynamic_event 是 PTODSL RuntimeValue，raw PTO op 需要 MLIR Value。
静态 event 是 Python int，所以静态的 0/1/16/17 可以正常建立；第一次动态 wait 才暴露问题。
### 4. 不是 PTOAS 自动插入同步
虽然 kernel 带有 insert_sync=True，但函数已经存在显式 set_flag/wait_flag，PTOAS InsertSync 会直接跳过。
并且 InsertSync 不生成本次涉及的 cross-core sync.set/sync.wait。PIPE_MTE1 来自 TileLang scheduler，不是 PTOAS 底层添加的。
最合理、最安全的修改方法
建议只修改三个窄点。
#### 1. PTOAS verifier
A5 SyncSetOp 白名单改为：
PIPE_FIX
PIPE_MTE1
PIPE_MTE3
SyncWaitOp 保持现有：
PIPE_FIX
PIPE_MTE1
PIPE_MTE2
PIPE_MTE3
PIPE_V
只增加已经被本算子、AscendC 和 CANN 证明需要的 PIPE_MTE1。不要顺便放开未经验证的其他 set pipe。
#### 2. PTODSL 公共接口
让 facade 与 verifier 完全一致：
set_intra_flag:
    FIX, MTE1, MTE3

wait_intra_flag:
    FIX, MTE1, MTE2, MTE3, V
该接口已有正确的动态值处理：
unwrap_surface_value(event_id)
因此应该让这一层统一负责 RuntimeValue 转换和 event 范围检查。
#### 3. TileLang codegen
mode 4 不再直接生成 raw _tl_pto_ops.sync_*，而是生成：
pto.set_intra_flag(pipe, event_id)
pto.wait_intra_flag(pipe, event_id)
同时使用 set/wait 各自的白名单：
set : FIX, MTE1, MTE3
wait: FIX, MTE1, MTE2, MTE3, V
这样：
动态 event 自动解包
静态 [0,31] 校验集中在 PTODSL
TileLang、PTODSL、PTOAS 三层契约完全一致
每个原始同步仍严格对应一个 PTO 同步

### Reproduction (minimal)

```markdown
TileKernels-Nightly/tile_kernels/mhc/norm_fn_asc.py
这个算子全部改为 target="pto" 后运行可复现。
TileKernels-Nightly/tile_kernels/modeling/mhc/ops/norm_fn.py 中需要对应真值修改：

    @staticmethod
    def backward(
        ctx: 'MHCGemmWithSqrsum',
        out_mul_grad: torch.Tensor,
        sqrsum_grad: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor | None, None, None]:
        x, fn = ctx.saved_tensors

        mhc_mult3, mhc_hidden_size = fn.shape

        out_mul_grad = out_mul_grad[0]
        sqrsum_grad = sqrsum_grad[0]

        if ctx.fuse_grad_acc:
            x_grad: torch.Tensor = x.untyped_storage().grad_from_mhc_post.view_as(x)
        else:
            x_grad = torch.zeros_like(x)
        fn_grad = torch.empty_like(fn)

        out_mul_grad = round_to_tf32(out_mul_grad)

        if is_ascend():
            out_mul_grad_2d = out_mul_grad.view(-1, mhc_mult3)
            sqrsum_grad_2d = sqrsum_grad.view(-1, 1)
            x_2d = x.view(-1, mhc_hidden_size)
            x_f32 = x_2d.float()

            fn_grad.copy_(out_mul_grad_2d.t().matmul(x_f32))
            x_grad_f32 = x_grad.view(-1, mhc_hidden_size).float()
            x_grad_f32.add_(out_mul_grad_2d.matmul(fn))
            x_grad_f32.add_(2.0 * x_f32 * sqrsum_grad_2d)
            x_grad.copy_(x_grad_f32.to(x_grad.dtype).view_as(x_grad))
        else:
            mhc_gemm_with_sqrsum_bwd(
                out_mul_grad.view(-1, 1, mhc_mult3),
                sqrsum_grad.view(-1, 1),
                x.view(-1, mhc_hidden_size),
                fn,
                x_grad.view(-1, mhc_hidden_size),
                fn_grad,
                token_block=128,
                hidden_block=128,
                use_pdl=get_pdl(),
            )
```

能够正确处理 PIPE_MTE1

## #1124 [Bug] [阻塞] vstus emitter 生成固定裸名 llvm.hivm.vstus，同 kernel 内多类型混用导致 conflicting declaration

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1124
- Created: 2026-08-04T07:11:54Z
- Updated: 2026-08-06T11:17:56Z
- Closed: 2026-08-06T11:17:56Z

### Body

### Component

PTO Dialect / ODS (include/PTO/IR)

### Description

buildVstusCallee（VPTOCANN900LLVMEmitter.cpp:2301、VPTOLLVMEmitter.cpp:2345）对所有 pto.vstus 调用都生成固定裸名 llvm.hivm.vstus（无类型后缀）。当同一个 kernel 内出现不同 value 类型的 vstus 调用时（如 ui8 + f32），LLVM 模块内同名函数出现不同参数签名，触发 conflicting declaration 编译错误。


### Reproduction (minimal)

```markdown
复现步骤
1. 写一个最小 ptodsl kernel，内含两种类型的 vstus：
@pto.jit(name="demo_vstus_conflict", target="a5", kernel_kind="vector")
def _k():
    st = pto.alloc_tile(shape=[1, 128], dtype=pto.f32, valid_shape=[1, 128])
    dt_f32 = pto.alloc_tile(shape=[1, 128], dtype=pto.f32, valid_shape=[1, 128])
    dt_u8 = pto.alloc_tile(shape=[1, 128], dtype=pto.ui8, valid_shape=[1, 128])
    src_ptr = st.as_ptr()
    dst_f32_ptr = dt_f32.as_ptr()
    dst_u8_ptr = dt_u8.as_ptr()
    v_f32 = pto.vlds(src_ptr, 0)
    v_u8 = pto.vbitcast(v_f32, pto.ui8)
    ureg1 = pto.init_align()
    ureg1 = pto.vstus(ureg1, 1, v_f32, dst_f32_ptr)       # f32 vstus
    pto.vstas(ureg1, pto.addptr(dst_f32_ptr, 1), 0)
    ureg2 = pto.init_align()
    ureg2 = pto.vstus(ureg2, 1, v_u8, dst_u8_ptr)          # ui8 vstus
    pto.vstas(ureg2, pto.addptr(dst_u8_ptr, 1), 0)
    pto.pipe_barrier(pto.Pipe.ALL)
2. 生成 MLIR 并用 ptoas 编译：
ptoas --pto-arch=a5 --enable-insert-sync --enable-tile-op-expand \
  kernel.mlir -o kernel.o
```

### Expected behavior

编译通过

### Actual behavior / error logs

```text
VPTO LLVM emission failed: conflicting declaration for llvm.hivm.vstus
Error: Failed to lower VPTO to LLVM modules.
```

ac11080a6de5cf13e97153670837f8aafa309b88

## #1126 [Bug] ast_rewrite branch merge 类型不匹配：bool buffer load 返回 i8，条件变量期望 i1

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1126
- Created: 2026-08-04T07:15:38Z
- Updated: 2026-08-12T04:25:52Z
- Closed: 2026-08-12T04:25:52Z

### Body

### Component

Verifier / IR semantics (lib/PTO/IR)

### Description

PTODSL 的 ast_rewrite 在 branch merge 时，如果 then 分支从 bool buffer 读取值（`scalar.load` 返回 i8），else 分支是 i1 常量（`pto.const(0, dtype=pto.i1)`），会报类型不匹配错误：

```
RuntimeError: br.assign(...) type mismatch for 'cond': then branch yields i8, else branch yields i1
```

### Reproduction (minimal)

```markdown
from ptodsl import pto, scalar

@pto.jit(name="repro_bool_merge", target="a5")
def kernel(flag: pto.ptr(pto.i8, "gm")) -> pto.i32:
    cond = pto.const(0, dtype=pto.i1)

    if pto.const(1, dtype=pto.i32):
        cond = scalar.load(flag, 0)

    if cond:
        return pto.const(42, dtype=pto.i32)
    return pto.const(0, dtype=pto.i32)

print(kernel.compile().mlir_text())
```

### Expected behavior

ast_rewrite 在 branch merge 时，如果 then/else 分支类型不一致但可以安全转换（如 i8→i1 的非零语义），应自动插入转换（如 `cond != 0` 或等价的 i1 转换），而不是直接报错。

### Actual behavior / error logs

```text
RuntimeError: br.assign(...) type mismatch for 'cond': then branch yields i8, else branch yields i1
```

470e8832（main + PR #1029 cherry-pick）

- Created: 2026-08-04T09:32:49Z

- Closed: 

### Body

## 背景

PR #1104 当前以 `pto.struct_get` / `pto.struct_set` 作为与 PTO IR 对齐的 canonical API。为了提升 PTODSL 的易用性，需要单独设计 class/成员访问形式。

关联 review：https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/pull/1104#discussion_r3710314401

## 目标

- 设计可声明命名字段的 PTODSL struct 表层。
- 支持成员读取、写入与嵌套成员访问，并无损 lower 到现有 `pto.struct_get` / `pto.struct_set`。

- 明确字段命名、Python class 声明方式、字面量 materialization 与诊断规则。

## 非目标

- 不改变 `!pto.struct` 的存储模型、ABI、生命周期或后端 lowering。
- 不支持动态字段名、动态索引或将 struct 用作函数 ABI。

- 嵌套成员读写能生成与显式 path API 等价的 PTO IR。
- 覆盖 PTODSL 单测、文档示例与 EmitC/VPTO 编译路径。

## #1135 dyn vci remat binds Sn[0]=0 after A0+A1 pressure (camodel); llvm.hivm still has offset

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1135
- Created: 2026-08-04T13:23:26Z
- Updated: 2026-08-13T08:53:08Z
- Closed: 2026-08-13T08:53:08Z

### Body

## Summary

After dense **raw `vci(dyn)` (A0)** + **`vci(0)+vadds` (A1)** pressure, a later rematerialized **`vci(pass*384+64)` (B0)** executes on camodel with **`Sn[0]=0x0`** (lane-id ramp) instead of the absolute base (`448` / `Sn[24]=0x1c0` still alive unused).

Pre-bisheng **`llvm.hivm.vci(i32 %dyn)` still carries the correct offset**. SoftPost off. Not fixed by rewriting offset math to pure i32 mul/add (no i64 trunc) — same Sn binding / FAIL.

Related prior: #1092 / #1093 (nonzero / imm `vci` encoding). This is a **different** failure mode: **register-form dyn `vci` under Sn pressure / isel**, not imm-base drop alone.

## Minimal repro (TileLang → PTOAS → camodel)

Committed on `tilelang-deepseek` `feat/topk-gate-vmi-staged`:

- File: `examples/ascend/vmi/topk_gate/topk_gate_vmi_vci_problem.py`
- Commit: `77192faf` (`test(topk_gate): add minimal camodel repro for dyn vci Sn[0] drop`)

```bash
source ~/projects/env.sh   # or equiv: PTOAS_ROOT, ASCEND 9.1b3, TILELANG
unset SoftPost SOFT_POST ASCEND_SOFT_POST
export TILELANG_DISABLE_CACHE=1
cd .../examples/ascend/vmi/topk_gate
PROBE=$PWD/topk_gate_vmi_vci_problem.py
python3 "$PROBE" --compile-only --so /tmp/topk_gate_vmi_vci_problem.so
bash $PTOAS_ROOT/scripts/sim_dsl.sh --output /tmp/topk_gate_vmi_vci_problem_out \
  "$PROBE" -- --so /tmp/topk_gate_vmi_vci_problem.so
# exit 0 + STATUS=PROBLEM_REPRODUCED
```

Kernel shape (no `group=`, `VL=64`, `CHUNKS=5`):

| Stage | Ops |
|-------|-----|
| A0 | 2×5 raw `vci(offset)` + vstore |
| A1 | 2×5 `vci(0)+vadds(offset)` + vstore |
| B0 | 2× `vci(pass*384+64)` + vstore (oracle last = 448) |

Bisect: **chunks=4 PASS, chunks=5 FAIL**; both A0 and A1 required; B1/B2/vcmp/vbrc/mem_bar not required.

## Evidence

**Host oracle (FAIL):**
```text
A0/A1 slot448 absolute OK
B0 dump[0]=0 dump[46]=46   # want 448/494
STATUS=PROBLEM_REPRODUCED
```

**Pre-bisheng LLVM (offset still present):**
```llvm
%82 = phi i16 ...
%85 = sext i16 %82 to i64
%86 = mul i64 %85, 384
%87 = add i64 %86, 64
%88 = trunc i64 %87 to i32
%89 = call <64 x i32> @llvm.hivm.vci.v64s32(i32 %88, i32 0)  ; still %88
```

**Camodel B0:**
```text
RV_VCI  Sn[0]=0x0          ← should be 0x1c0
RV_VSTI Sn[0]=0x0
; Sn[24]=0x1c0 (448) still live, used earlier by A1 RV_VADDS, not by this VCI
```

## What we ruled out

- SoftPost CSE of dyn base across `scf.for`
- PTOAS dropping the dyn SSA before `llvm.hivm` emit
- Need for `group=`
- Offset expression shape (`pass*384+64` / `pass*VL` / `pass+448` all FAIL under A0+A1)
- Rewriting to `phi/cast → mul/add i32 → vci(i32)` (no trunc): **same camodel Sn / RVECSU**

## Suspected layer

Post-PTOAS **bisheng / HIVM isel / Sn operand binding** for `llvm.hivm.vci.v64s32(%dyn)` when a hoisted `vci(0)` occupies `Sn[0]` and many other Sn slots hold absolute bases.

## Workaround

Prefer remat via **`vci(0)+vadds(offset)`** (A1-style) instead of raw dyn `vci(offset)` after pressure.

## Ask

1. Confirm whether HIVM/`RV_VCI` Sn binding should keep `%dyn` live across VF when `Sn[0]` already holds 0 from an earlier `vci(0)`.
2. Is there a known volatile / don’t-CSE / materialize-to-fresh-Sn requirement for VCI bases?
3. Please treat this TileLang camodel probe as an e2e gate (not gym-only constant/`vci` cases).

## #1141 [Bug] [阻塞] 缺少 unsigned SIMD arithmetic/bitwise/shift 原生 lowering，影响 uint16/uint32 量化算子

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1141
- Created: 2026-08-05T02:47:56Z
- Updated: 2026-08-05T03:24:45Z
- Closed: 2026-08-05T03:24:45Z

### Body

### Component

Python bindings (python/)

### Description

PTODSL/PTOAS 目前缺少 unsigned SIMD arithmetic/bitwise/shift 的原生 lowering 能力。

TileLang PTO backend 之前曾通过 `vbitcast -> signed SIMD op -> vbitcast` 临时模拟 unsigned SIMD，但该方式会把 unsigned 语义静默映射到 signed op 上，尤其对最高位为 1 的 `uint16/uint32` 数据存在语义风险。因此 TileLang 已删除该临时规避，现在需要 PTOAS/PTODSL 提供 native unsigned SIMD 支持。

受影响的典型 op：

```text
uint16:
- vector op: vor

uint32:
- scalar SIMD op: vadds
- scalar SIMD op: vshrs

### Reproduction (minimal)

```markdown
from ptodsl import pto


@pto.jit(
    name="unsigned_simd_probe",
    kernel_kind="vector",
    target="a5",
    backend="vpto",
    mode="explicit",
)
def unsigned_simd_probe(
    src_u16: pto.ptr(pto.ui16, "gm"),
    dst_u16: pto.ptr(pto.ui16, "gm"),
    src_u32: pto.ptr(pto.ui32, "gm"),
    dst_u32: pto.ptr(pto.ui32, "gm"),
):
    mask = pto.Mask("32T")

    # case 1: uint16 vector bitwise OR
    v16 = pto.vload(src_u16, 0, mask)
    one16 = pto.vdup(pto.const(1, dtype=pto.ui16), mask)
    out16 = pto.vor(v16, one16, mask)
    pto.vstore(out16, dst_u16, 0, mask)

    # case 2: uint32 vector-scalar add
    v32 = pto.vload(src_u32, 0, mask)
    out32_add = pto.vadds(v32, pto.const(1, dtype=pto.ui32), mask)

    # case 3: uint32 vector-scalar logical right shift
    out32_shr = pto.vshrs(out32_add, pto.const(1, dtype=pto.ui32), mask)
    pto.vstore(out32_shr, dst_u32, 0, mask)

如果 pto.const(..., dtype=pto.ui16/ui32) 的写法和当前 PTODSL API 不一致，也可以换成 PTOAS 侧等价的 unsigned scalar/vector 构造方式。关键是验证以下 native unsigned SIMD lowering：

pto.vor  on ui16 vector
pto.vadds on ui32 vector
pto.vshrs on ui32 vector
```

### Expected behavior

希望PTODSL/PTOAS 提供 unsigned SIMD op 的原生 lowering，不要求上层 codegen 通过 signed bitcast 模拟。
希望以下 op 对 unsigned element dtype 有明确原生语义：
vector-vector:
- vadd
- vsub
- vand
- vor
- vshl
- vshr

vector-scalar:
- vadds
- vshls
- vshrs


### Actual behavior / error logs

```text
当前报错为TileLang 主动暴露出来的 PTOAS/PTODSL 能力缺口。
PTO unsigned SIMD scalar op requires native PTOAS support, got tl.simd.vadds for uint32
PTO unsigned SIMD scalar op requires native PTOAS support, got tl.simd.vshrs for uint32
PTO unsigned SIMD op requires native PTOAS support, got tl.simd.vor for uint16
```

### Git commit

1309ee9ffca5e74d7ac020f522a27b8907b5621c 

### Host platform

None

### Target Ascend arch (if relevant)

a5

### PTOAS build level (if relevant)

## #1143 [VPTO] 建立可扩展的资源与寄存器压力感知指令调度框架

- State: open
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1143
- Created: 2026-08-05T03:14:26Z
- Updated: 2026-08-05T06:08:30Z
- Closed: 

### Body

## 1. 背景：现在缺的是什么

PTOAS 已默认在 VPTO device object emission 时向 Bisheng 传入 `--cce-aicore-vec-misched=0`，避免 Bisheng vector MISched 破坏 PTOAS 生成的指令顺序：

- [mouliangyu/PTOAS#508](https://github.com/mouliangyu/PTOAS/issues/508)：Bisheng 将交错的 `vcmp -> vsel` 重新聚集，扩大 predicate live range，并引入 PLDI/PSTI/SMEM_BAR；关闭 vector MISched 后 spill 消失。
- [mouliangyu/PTOAS#574](https://github.com/mouliangyu/PTOAS/issues/574)：AABBCC 场景开启 MISched 后 EXIPC 从约 0.935 降至约 0.274，并出现大量 predicate spill/barrier。

关闭有害的下游调度只能保留 PTOAS 当前顺序，不能主动构造兼顾 latency hiding、资源利用率和寄存器压力的顺序。PTOAS 目前缺少自主可控的 VPTO 指令调度框架。

本 Issue 的目标不是增加一个 `vcmp -> vsel` 专用重排 pass，而是建立可持续补充 A5 模型、pressure set 和调度策略的通用框架。

## 2. 已确定的设计决策

| 项目 | 决策 |
|---|---|
| 实现层 | MLIR/VPTO，不复用 CIRCT scheduling |
| 插入点 | `prepareVPTOForEmission` 最后一轮 CSE 后、`PTOValidateVPTOEmissionIR` 前 |
| 调度阶段 | 相对于 Bisheng hardware RA 的 pre-RA |
| 首版 region | block 内 scheduling region |
| 首版策略 | deterministic top-down list scheduling |
| 框架方向 | 支持多个 resource/pressure set，并预留 top/bottom boundary |
| 模型维护 | 首版静态 C++ 表；数值允许后续补充和校准 |
| 下游调度 | 保持当前 Bisheng vector MISched 默认关闭 |
| 失败策略 | unknown 保序，超预算或验证失败时 rollback |
| 非首版范围 | 跨 block、bidirectional 策略、bundle/bank conflict、software pipelining |

实际 pass 位置：

```text
VMIToVPTO
  -> wrapper expansion / vecscope / optional soft post-update
  -> LICM / canonicalize / CSE
  -> VPTOSchedulerPass
  -> PTOValidateVPTOEmissionIR
  -> LLVM emission
  -> Bisheng（vector MISched 默认已关闭）
```

此时 `!pto.vreg`、`!pto.mask` 和 `!pto.align` 已经是独立的低级 VPTO SSA value，但尚未分配硬件寄存器编号。

## 3. 一个最小例子

考虑下面的 VPTO 顺序：

```mlir
%p0 = pto.vcmp ...
%p1 = pto.vcmp ...
%r0 = pto.vsel ..., %p0
%r1 = pto.vsel ..., %p1
```

执行完两个 `vcmp` 后，`%p0` 和 `%p1` 同时存活，Predicate pressure 峰值为 2。合法的交错顺序是：

```mlir
%p0 = pto.vcmp ...
%r0 = pto.vsel ..., %p0
%p1 = pto.vcmp ...
%r1 = pto.vsel ..., %p1
```

此时 Predicate pressure 峰值为 1。

调度框架完成这次选择需要：

1. 从 op/SSA 语义得知 `vcmp` 定义 mask、`vsel` 使用 mask。
2. 在 DAG 中建立 `%p0 -> %r0`、`%p1 -> %r1` 的 Must edge。
3. 从 TargetModel 查询 `vcmp/vsel` 的 resource、latency 和 pressure-set 映射。
4. 在 Boundary 中计算 ready、resource 和所有 pressure set 的变化。
5. 由 Strategy 选择 candidate，再由 Verifier 检查最终顺序。

同一套 pressure tracking 机制也用于 Vector、Scalar、Address、Align 和 Special；框架不硬编码某一种 pressure 更重要，具体 limit、weight 和 spill cost 由模型提供。

## 4. 端到端调用链

```text
VPTOSchedulerPass
  |
  +-- 创建/取得 VPTOSchedModel
  |
  +-- VPTOSchedRegionBuilder
  |      Block -> VPTOSchedRegion[]
  |
  +-- 对每个 Region：
         |
         +-- VPTOSchedDAGBuilder
         |      Region + Op semantic + Model -> VPTOSchedDAG
         |
         +-- VPTOScheduler
         |      DAG + Model + Strategy -> VPTOScheduleResult
         |
         +-- VPTOScheduleVerifier
                success -> apply result
                failure -> 保留原顺序
```

Scheduler 内部调用链：

```text
VPTOScheduler
  |
  +-- VPTOScheduleContext
         |
         +-- TopBoundary
         |      +-- available/pending queues
         |      +-- ResourceTracker
         |      +-- RegPressureTracker
         |      +-- HazardRecognizer
         |
         +-- BottomBoundary
                +-- 相同结构，首版不参与选择

VPTOScheduler
  -> 构造 Candidates
  -> 调用 Strategy.pickCandidate(Candidates)
  <- 获得 Decision {unit, direction, reason}
  -> Boundary.commit(Decision)
```

Scheduler 是驱动者。Strategy 不直接修改 DAG、IR、queue 或 tracker，只负责从已经合法的 Candidates 中选择一个 Decision。

## 5. 组件职责与数据所有权

### 组件职责

| 组件 | 输入 | 输出/持有 | 调用者 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VPTOSchedulerPass` | Function/Block | 最终 VPTO 顺序 | pass pipeline |
| `VPTOSchedRegionBuilder` | Block | scheduling regions | Pass |
| `VPTOSchedDAGBuilder` | Region + Op semantic + Model | DAG | Pass |
| `VPTOSchedModel` | Op/Value | sched class、resource、latency、pressure set | DAGBuilder/Tracker |
| `VPTOScheduler` | DAG + Model + Strategy | Result | Pass |
| `VPTOSchedBoundary` | DAG ready state | queue、cycle、resource/pressure/hazard state | Scheduler |
| `VPTOSchedStrategy` | Candidates + read-only context | Decision | Scheduler |
| `VPTOScheduleVerifier` | Region + DAG + Result | success/failure | Pass |

### 数据所有权

```text
Pass
  owns Model and current Region/DAG/Result

Scheduler
  owns ScheduleContext

ScheduleContext
  owns TopBoundary and BottomBoundary

Boundary
  owns queues and Resource/Pressure/Hazard tracker state

Strategy
  owns no scheduling state
```

## 6. 各组件需要提供的能力

### 6.1 Op semantic

普通 SSA def-use 直接来自 operands/results；普通内存读写优先使用 `MemoryEffectOpInterface`；执行 pipe 使用现有 `OpPipeInterface`。

新增 ODS `VPTOSchedulingOpInterface`，只补充通用 MLIR 信息无法表达的 op-local 语义：

- 隐式状态和特殊寄存器读写；
- memory space、访问范围、volatile/atomic、post-update；
- barrier、event、pipe 和 buf-id 同步；
- 其他影响调度合法性的属性。

Op 只报告“自己访问或修改了什么”。两个 op 是否 alias、是否建立 memory edge，由 DAGBuilder 统一判断。首版不能证明 no-alias 时保守保持原顺序。

所有可能到达 scheduler 插入点的 op 必须分类为：

```text
Schedulable / Structural / SchedulingBoundary / Unsupported
```

新增 op 未分类时默认成为 boundary，并在 coverage/测试中报告。

### 6.2 RegionBuilder 与 DAGBuilder

RegionBuilder 根据 terminator、region op、call、barrier 和 unknown side effect 划分 block 内可调度范围。

DAG node 对应一个 VPTO op；edge 至少包含：

```text
kind:     Data / Anti / Output / Memory / Control / Sync / Artificial / Cluster
strength: Must / Weak
latency:  producer-consumer latency
reason:   建边原因，用于 trace
```

Must edge 是正确性约束；Weak/Cluster edge 只表达顺序偏好。DAG 同时维护未调度 predecessor/successor 计数，为 top-down 和未来 bottom-up ready queue 提供统一基础。

首版 memory 规则：

- 不同确定 address space 默认不 alias；
- 同一 space 的 read/read 可重排；
- 任一方为 write 且不能证明 no-alias 时保持原顺序；
- volatile、atomic、unknown range 和 unknown effect 保守保序；
- local memory 需要考虑 PlanMemory 后不同 SSA root 复用同一物理范围；
- post-update 同时保留地址 SSA 依赖和 memory dependence。

### 6.3 TargetModel

`VPTOSchedModel` 是只读目标查询接口。首版使用静态 C++ 表，后续可由 TableGen 生成，但 scheduler 不依赖模型存储格式。

模型包含：

| 类别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| Machine | target/model version、issue width、micro-op buffer、模型完整度 |
| Resource/SchedClass | resource units/group/buffer、reservation、micro-ops、latency、read advance/bypass、group/issue 约束 |
| PressureSet | Vector、Predicate、Scalar、Address、Align、Special 等 set 的 value units，以及可选 limit、weight、spill cost |

即使 pressure limit 尚未确定，Tracker 仍计算每个 set 的 current、peak 和 candidate delta。后续只更新模型数据，不修改 Tracker 或 Strategy 接口。

模型解析结果分为：

```text
KnownSchedClass
UnknownSchedClass
```

语义未知的 op成为 region boundary；语义已知但模型未知的 op 使用保守 UnknownSchedClass、保持必要的原始顺序，并计入 analyze coverage。

### 6.4 Boundary 与 Trackers

每个 Boundary 持有：

```text
direction + current cycle
available/pending queues
ResourceTracker state
RegPressureTracker state
HazardRecognizer state
```

各 Tracker 职责：

- `ResourceTracker`：计算 candidate 的 ready cycle、issue slot 和 reservation 占用。
- `RegPressureTracker`：根据 region live-in/live-out 和最后一次 use 更新所有 pressure set。
- `HazardRecognizer`：处理资源表难以表达的 issue/pair/间隔限制。

正确性相关的 memory/sync/implicit-state 约束必须进入 DAG Must edge或 region boundary，不能只依赖近似 HazardRecognizer。物理寄存器、spill、NOP 等 post-RA hazard 仍由 Bisheng 负责。

### 6.5 Scheduler 与 Strategy

一轮调度固定执行：

```text
1. 从 Boundary 取得 available nodes。
2. ResourceTracker 计算 ready/resource delta。
3. RegPressureTracker 计算所有 pressure set delta。
4. HazardRecognizer 过滤当前 boundary 下非法的 node。
5. Scheduler 构造 Candidate 列表。
6. Strategy 选择 Decision。
7. Scheduler 提交 resource/pressure/hazard 状态。
8. DAG 标记节点已调度并更新依赖计数。
9. Boundary 释放新的 ready nodes。
10. 全部完成后产生 Result。
```

首版 Strategy 使用确定性比较：

```text
hard legality
 -> 避免增加已知 pressure-limit excess
 -> 减少 dependency/resource stall，优先关键路径
 -> 比较模型提供的 weighted pressure/resource delta
 -> original order tie-break
```

各 pressure set 使用同一套比较机制；limit/weight 未填写时使用统一默认值。

Scheduler 中的 cycle/resource timeline 是预计发射模型。首版只重排线性 VPTO op，不插入 NOP、不生成 bundle，也不保证估算 cycle 在 Bisheng 后精确复现。

### 6.6 Result 与 Verifier

`VPTOScheduleResult` 保存新顺序、预计 cycle、统计和 trace，不直接修改 IR。

Semantic verifier 在 apply 前检查：

- Result 是原 region op 的完整 permutation；
- 所有 Must edge 顺序合法；
- SSA dominance、memory、implicit state、sync、barrier 和 control 约束未破坏；
- terminator、region ownership、location 和 attributes 保留。

通过后继续运行现有 `PTOValidateVPTOEmissionIR`。任何失败都保留原顺序。

Model replay 重新计算 ready cycle、resource reservation、hazard 和 pressure timeline，用于发现 scheduler/model 实现错误；初期模型数据不精确，因此不将其当作硬件语义正确性的证明。

## 7. 必须稳定的数据契约

第一版需要固定职责，而不是一次确定所有 C++ 字段名：

| 对象 | 稳定职责 |
|---|---|
| `VPTOSchedRegion` | 可独立重排的 block 内 op 范围和边界 |
| `VPTOSUnit` / `VPTOSchedEdge` | node、typed dependency、latency、strength、reason |
| `VPTOSchedModel` | 查询 sched class、resource、latency、pressure set |
| `VPTOSchedBoundary` | 某一方向的 queues、cycle 和 tracker state |
| `VPTOSchedCandidate` | unit 在某方向上的 ready/resource/pressure 变化 |
| `VPTOSchedDecision` | Strategy 选择的 unit、direction、reason |
| `VPTOScheduleResult` | 新顺序、预计 cycle、统计和 trace |

核心关系：

```text
SchedClass  = micro-ops + resource uses + write latency + read advance
PressureSet = value units + optional limit/weight/spill cost
Boundary    = direction + queues + resource/pressure/hazard state
```

## 8. 首版实施清单

### 阶段一：framework + analyze

- [ ] `VPTOSchedulingOpInterface` 和 emission-stage op 分类/coverage。
- [ ] Region、SUnit、typed edge 和 DAGBuilder。
- [ ] TargetModel、SchedClass、Resource、PressureSet 完整契约。
- [ ] Top/Bottom Boundary 数据结构。
- [ ] 通用 ResourceTracker、RegPressureTracker、HazardRecognizer 接口。
- [ ] `--vpto-scheduler={off,analyze,on}`。
- [ ] analyze 输出 DAG、edge reason、resource/pressure timeline、model coverage 和 fallback reason，不修改 IR。

退出标准：能够对真实 VPTO block 输出可信 DAG 和所有已注册 pressure set 的 current/peak/delta，并能解释每个保序边界和未覆盖 op。

### 阶段二：working scheduler

- [ ] 确定性 top-down Strategy。
- [ ] 首批常见 Vector、load/store、predicate 和同步 op模型。
- [ ] Scheduler、Result、semantic verifier、model replay 和 rollback。
- [ ] emission 前 pass 接入和 compile-time budget。
- [ ] scheduler on 时保持当前 Bisheng vector MISched 默认关闭；若用户显式重新开启则给出诊断。

退出标准：现有 VPTO correctness tests 全部通过；调度结果确定可复现；unknown、超预算和验证失败路径可靠回退。

## 9. 验收标准

### CLI 行为

```text
off     -> VPTO 输出与当前基线一致
analyze -> IR 不变，只输出 DAG/resource/pressure/coverage
on      -> 只允许改变 scheduling region 内 op 顺序
```

`on + --enable-bisheng-vec-misched` 必须 warning 或 error；Verifier/model replay 失败必须输出原因并恢复原序。

### 测试

- 每类 dependency edge 的 DAG 单元测试。
- ResourceTracker 的多 unit、共享 resource、issue width 和 reservation 测试。
- RegPressureTracker 的 live-in/live-out、最后一次 use、多 pressure set 和 top/bottom direction 测试。
- 最小 VPTO compare/select fixture，验证聚集/交错顺序的 pressure 差异。
- 随机 DAG 的调度/验证 differential test。
- 全量 VPTO lit、ST 和 emission tests。

### 性能闭环

- 使用 `group-slots-fanout-store-broadcast`、`online-softmax-update` 等真实 VPTO kernel 覆盖 latency/resource 场景。
- #574 的 CCE AABBCC repro 作为性能目标参考；构造等价 VPTO fixture 后再纳入 scheduler CI。
- 比较调度前后关键路径、resource timeline、各 pressure set peak 和模型覆盖率。
- 比较最终 Bisheng assembly/instruction log 中的 PLDI、PSTI、SMEM_BAR、指令顺序和指令数。
- 使用 CA model simulator/NPU 测量 cycles、EXIPC、pipe occupancy 和 stall，不只依赖静态模型判断性能。

## 10. 后续与非目标

后续能力：

- 校准 A5 issue width、latency、throughput、reservation、bypass、pressure limit 和 spill cost；
- 启用 BottomBoundary 和 bidirectional Strategy；
- weak clustering、bundle/pair、bank conflict 和特殊 hazard；
- 跨 block region scheduling；
- software pipelining/modulo scheduling 单独立项。

非目标：

- 不建设高层 tile/pipeline 资源管理框架；
- 不实现面向特定 kernel 或特定 op pattern 的一次性调度 pass；
- 不直接 lower 到 LLVM `MachineInstr` 后再回写 VPTO。

## #1149 [Bug][阻塞] PTOAS lowering 两个问题导致 NPU kernel 死锁：flag hoisting 出 scf.if + simt_entry noinline

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1149
- Created: 2026-08-05T07:09:16Z
- Updated: 2026-08-07T09:58:32Z
- Closed: 2026-08-07T09:58:32Z

### Body

### Component

Other

### Description

PTO 后端编译的 vector kernel 在 NPU 上执行时永久 hang，stream sync 无限等待。经排查，PTOAS lowering pass 将 `set_flag`/`wait_flag` 操作从 `scf.if` 条件块内提升（hoist）到条件外，但对应的 MTE copy 和 SIMT compute 操作仍保留在条件内。这破坏了跨循环迭代的 flag 生命周期平衡，导致死锁。

此外，PTOAS 将 `simt_entry` 函数标记为 `noinline`，bisheng `-xcce` 可能无法跨函数边界做 pipe 指令调度，即使 flag 生命周期平衡也可能导致同步失败。

### Reproduction (minimal)

```markdown
@pto.jit(name="kernel", kernel_kind="vector", target="a5", mode="explicit")
def kernel(...):
    ...
    with pto.for_(0, N, step=1) as i:
        cond = i < remaining
        if _as_logical_bool(cond):
            pto.wait_flag("V", "MTE2", event_id=i)      # V 等 MTE2
            pto.mte_gm_ub(...)                           # MTE2 copy
            pto.set_flag("MTE2", "V", event_id=i)       # MTE2 通知 V
            pto.wait_flag("MTE2", "V", event_id=i)      # V 等 MTE2
            pto.store_vfsimt_info(...)
            simt_helper[...](...)                        # V 计算
            pto.set_flag("V", "MTE2", event_id=i)       # V 通知 MTE2

            pto.wait_flag("MTE3", "V", event_id=i)      # V 等 MTE3
            with pto.vecscope():
                ...                                      # V SIMD 计算
            pto.set_flag("V", "MTE3", event_id=i)       # V 通知 MTE3

            for bx in range(0, N):
                pto.barrier("MTE3")
                pto.wait_flag("V", "MTE3", event_id=i)  # MTE3 等 V
                pto.mte_ub_gm(...)                      # MTE3 copy
                pto.set_flag("MTE3", "V", event_id=i)   # MTE3 通知 V（供下一轮 i）

### Expected behavior


MLIR 中 `set_flag_dyn`/`wait_flag_dyn` 正确地在 `scf.if` 条件块内。当条件为 false 时，所有 flag 操作和数据操作都被跳过，flag 生命周期平衡：

```mlir
scf.for %arg17 = %c0 to %c4 step %c1 {
  %35 = arith.cmpi slt, %arg17, %34 : index

  scf.if %35 {                                    # ← flag 操作在条件内
    pto.wait_flag_dyn[<PIPE_V>, <PIPE_MTE2>, %arg17]    # V 等 MTE2
    pto.copy_gm_to_ubuf ...                              # MTE2 copy
    pto.set_flag_dyn[<PIPE_MTE2>, <PIPE_V>, %arg17]     # MTE2 通知 V
    pto.wait_flag_dyn[<PIPE_MTE2>, <PIPE_V>, %arg17]    # V 等 MTE2
    pto.store_vfsimt_info ...
    func.call @simt_vf_0__simt_0(...)                    # V 计算
    pto.set_flag_dyn[<PIPE_V>, <PIPE_MTE2>, %arg17]     # V 通知 MTE2

    pto.wait_flag_dyn[<PIPE_MTE3>, <PIPE_V>, %arg17]    # V 等 MTE3
    pto.vecscope { ... }                                 # V SIMD 计算
    pto.set_flag_dyn[<PIPE_V>, <PIPE_MTE3>, %arg17]     # V 通知 MTE3

    scf.for %arg18 = ... {                               # MTE3 copy 循环
      pto.barrier <PIPE_MTE3>
      pto.wait_flag_dyn[<PIPE_V>, <PIPE_MTE3>, %arg17]  # MTE3 等 V
      pto.copy_ubuf_to_gm ...                            # MTE3 copy
      pto.set_flag_dyn[<PIPE_MTE3>, <PIPE_V>, %arg17]   # MTE3 通知 V（供下一轮 i）
    }
  }
}
```

### Actual behavior / error logs

```text
PTOAS lowering 后，部分 `set_flag`/`wait_flag` 被提升出 `scf.if` 条件块，但 MTE copy 和 SIMT compute 仍在条件内：


BB 227:
    call WAIT.FLAG.REG(1, 4, %213)           # ← 提升！无条件执行
    br i1 %216 → BB 228 or BB 241

BB 228:                                      # ← 条件内（MTE2 copy）
    call MOV.OUT.TO.UB ...                   # MTE2 copy（仍条件内）

BB 241:                                      # ← 提升！无条件执行
    call SET.FLAG.REG(4, 1, %213)            # ← MTE2 set（即使没做 copy）
    call WAIT.FLAG.REG(4, 1, %213)           # ← V wait
    br i1 %216 → BB 242 or BB 243

BB 242:                                      # ← 条件内（SIMT call）
    call store.vfsimt.info ...
    call simt_vf_0__simt_0(...)              # V compute（仍条件内）

BB 243:                                      # ← 提升！无条件执行
    call SET.FLAG.REG(1, 4, %213)            # ← V set（即使没做 compute）
    br i1 %216 → BB 244 or BB 316

BB 244:                                      # ← 条件内
    call WAIT.FLAG.REG(5, 1, %213)           # ← 仍条件内
    # V SIMD compute ...
    call SET.FLAG.REG(1, 5, %213)            # V→MTE3 set（仍条件内）

BB 292:                                      # ← 条件内

## #1150 feat(vmi): VMIPredicateFold — DCE compile-time expert-pad vcmp/vsel

- State: open
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1150
- Created: 2026-08-05T07:21:37Z
- Updated: 2026-08-06T08:12:13Z
- Closed: 

### Body

## Summary

Expert / length **padding** is a common VMI pattern: after `vci` (or `vadds(vci, C)`) builds lane indices over a physical VL tile, frontends emit

```text
score = vsel(vcmp(index, num_experts, lt), score, -inf)
```

so out-of-range lanes do not participate in reductions. When `num_experts` (and the index span) are **compile-time known** and the compare is provably **all-true**, this `vcmp`+`vsel` is an identity and should be removed by the compiler instead of requiring a hand-coded `need_pad = (E != aligned_E)` gate in every kernel.

## Motivation / pattern

| Pattern | Where it shows up |
|---|---|
| Expert-pad after VL-aligned score load | MoE **topk gate** (iterative argmax over `E` experts) |
| Tail-pad on last chunk / last page | Any kernel that tiles `E` or `N` to VL / UB alignment |
| Python `need_pad` strip | Frontends that special-case `E == aligned_E` to omit IR |

Hand-gating is brittle: even when `need_pad=True` for a tail chunk, **non-tail** chunks are still all-true and should DCE.

## Primary consumer: `topk_gate` VMI

TileLang `topk_gate_vmi` can always emit pad masking and rely on PTOAS:

```python
# mask_padded_scores — always emit; VMIPredicateFold DCEs identity pads
score = vsel(vcmp(index, num_exp, mask, "lt"), score, -inf)
```

Reference shapes: DeepSeek-scale **E=384 K=9**, Mixtral-like **E=16 K=2**, Qwen/OLMoE-like **E=64 K=8**.

Related consumer PR: https://github.com/WenboCodes/tilelang-deepseek/pull/162

## Design (pass)

- **Pass:** `vmi-predicate-fold` (`VMIPredicateFold`)
- **Pipeline:** VMI semantic pipeline, **before** `VMILowerUnifiedToLegacy`
- **Range lattice:** `vci` / `vadds(vci, C)` / `vbrc(C)` / simple affine `iv*stride+C` with known `scf.for` bounds (+ cast peel); optional `{group=N}` attr read for packed VL
- **Folds:** all-true/false `vcmp` lattice; identity/constant `vsel`; pure-op DCE
- **Shared helpers:** `VMIMaskUtils` (`isAllActiveSeed` / `isAllInactiveSeed`)
- **A/B knob:** `--disable-vmi-predicate-fold` (via `PTO_FLAGS`)

Lit ST: `test/lit/vmi_new/vmi_predicate_fold_pad.pto`.

## Performance regression (camodel Ascend950PR, N=4)

Fair A/B: **same kernel** (pad always emitted), pass OFF vs ON.

| Config | g | RVECEX before→after | elem/cycle | Δ epc |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|
| E=16 K=2 (real mixed pad) | 1 | 22 → 22 | 0.262 → 0.262 | **0%** |
| E=16 K=2 | 2 | 36 → 36 | 0.478 → 0.478 | **0%** |
| E=64 K=8 (identity pad) | 1 | 73 → **70** | 1.193 → **1.205** | **+1.0%** |
| E=64 K=8 | 2 | 138 → **134** | 2.376 → **2.404** | **+1.2%** |
| E=384 K=9 | 1 | 366 → **353** (−13) | 5.04 → **5.09** | **+1.0%** |
| E=384 K=9 | 2 | 714 → **695** (−19) | 8.49 → **8.60** | **+1.2%** |

When `E ≪ VL` the pad is real → no fold. When `E` covers the index span, dead pad drops from RVECEX (~1% wall). After fold, E=384 matches the old hand-`need_pad=False` rooftop (353 / 695).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Lit ST `vmi_predicate_fold_pad` PASS
- [ ] Pass enabled by default in VMI semantic pipeline
- [ ] topk_gate camodel A/B: identity-pad configs lose RVECEX; E≪VL unchanged
- [ ] Frontend may drop hand `need_pad` and always emit pad IR

## Also tracked

Earlier fork tracking: mouliangyu/PTOAS#580 / #581 (against `feature-vmi`).

## #1162 [Bug] PTODSL AST rewrite 导致 L1 blockscaled GEMM 的 section 局部变量未初始化

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1162
- Created: 2026-08-06T03:02:26Z
- Updated: 2026-08-06T14:35:11Z
- Closed: 2026-08-06T14:35:11Z

### Body

## 问题概述

TileLang 的 `example_blockscaled_gemm.py` 以 PTO 为目标编译 L1 blockscaled GEMM 时，在 PTODSL 对生成 Python 代码进行 tracing / AST rewrite 的阶段失败。失败发生在 PTO IR 生成、PTOAS lowering、二进制生成和 A5 运行之前，因此这是一个 PTODSL 前端的控制流重写问题。

PTOAS 版本 `e7cbd03a11534accb8784afc098ecb74b347bd03` 已经包含 #1119 的合入提交 `2ede61b82a3b2cce6972b202e97adc467529c2ae`。因此，#1119 修复了相关的 physical section 变量泄漏问题，但尚未覆盖当前 L1 的组合场景。

## 环境

- PTOAS：`e7cbd03a11534accb8784afc098ecb74b347bd03`，`ptoas --version` 为 `0.57`
- PTODSL：来自上述 PTOAS checkout，已包含 #1119
- TileLang：分支 `zjm/blockscaled-gemm-pto-codegen`，提交 `140fb5f1`
- 硬件：A5，`Ascend950PR_9589`
- 用例：`examples/ascend/example_blockscaled_gemm.py`，`target=pto`，FP8 E4M3，pair-packed `uint16` E8M0 scale，`M=N=K=256`

对照验证：相同 FP8 shape 的显式 L0 用例可以完成端到端执行，数值结果为 `rel_mean_diff=1.31494758e-07`。因此失败仅与 L1 生成 PTODSL 的控制流 / physical section 结构有关，不是 blockscaled GEMM 的数值路径问题。

## 实际结果

生成的 L1 PTODSL module 在 tracing 阶段失败，尚未生成二进制：

```text
UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable '__pto_section_1_m_tile'
where it is not associated with a value
```

验证机上保留的失败生成源码为 `kernel.ptodsl.py`，其相关结构如下：

```python
with pto.section("cube"):
    # TileLang persistent-tile 调度及 L1/Cube 计算
    if pto.get_block_idx() < 1:
        m_tile = ...
        n_tile = ...
    else:
        m_tile = ...
        n_tile = ...
    ...

with pto.section("vector"):
    # 输出路径；生成的控制流也会重绑定并使用 m_tile/n_tile
    if pto.get_block_idx() < 1:
        m_tile = ...
        n_tile = ...
    else:
        m_tile = ...
        n_tile = ...
    ...
```

完整 kernel 包含常规的 L1 blockscaled staging/MAD template。错误发生于生成 Python 函数的 AST rewrite / tracing，因此尚未到达 PTODSL MLIR 或 PTOAS 的诊断阶段。

## #1119 为什么相关但不足以解决

#1119 新增 `_SectionLexicalRewriter`，将 section 内的变量重绑定（如 `m_tile`）改名为 `__pto_section_1_m_tile` 这类 alias，并将 `section_entry_bindings` 传给 `_ControlFlowRewriter`。

现有测试分别覆盖了两个独立场景：

- `lexical_section_rebinding_probe`：相邻的 Cube/Vector section 中的普通重绑定；
- `lexical_section_conditional_rebinding_probe`：单个 Cube section 内 runtime `if` 的重绑定。

当前 L1 kernel 同时组合了三者：相邻 physical section、`if pto.get_block_idx() < 1` 的运行时分支、以及 `m_tile`/`n_tile` 的重复重绑定和使用。生成的 Vector section alias 在 Python 尚未赋值时被读取，因此出现上述 `UnboundLocalError`。

初步判断，问题位于 section-local alias / `section_entry_bindings` 与 `_ControlFlowRewriter._rewrite_if` 分支 SSA merge 的交互。重写器在生成旧值读取或 `BranchHandle.get()` merge 前，需要为 alias 提供当前 section 内可支配的初始定义；不能将 sibling section 的局部 SSA 值作为初始定义。

## 期望行为

对每个 physical section，AST rewrite 应当二选一：

1. 对 section 内动态重绑定且后续仍会读取的 `m_tile`/`n_tile` 等变量，生成合法的 section-local 初始化及 SSA merge；
2. 若作者确实写出了不支持的跨 section 值依赖，则在 PTODSL AST-rewrite / tracing 阶段给出明确诊断。

不应抛出 Python `UnboundLocalError`，也不应通过放宽作用域让 section-local 值泄漏到 sibling section 来规避问题。

预期结果是该 L1 kernel 能完成 PTODSL tracing 并进入后续 PTOAS 编译；后端的 physical-section boundary verifier 应继续保持严格。

## 建议回归测试

建议在 `ptodsl/tests/test_section.py` 增加一个 probe，在同一函数中组合：

- sibling `pto.section("cube")` 和 `pto.section("vector")`；
- 每个 section 中都有 `if pto.get_block_idx() < 1`；
- 使用相同的作者变量名（`m_tile`、`n_tile`）进行 section-local scalar 重绑定；
- 动态分支之后继续读取这些值，最好再覆盖 loop / persistent scheduling 形态；
- `compile()` 成功，且生成 MLIR 中 `scf.if` 的 result/operand 满足 dominance。

这应精确覆盖 #1119 两个现有 probe 之间的缺口。额外增加一个由 TileLang L1 blockscaled GEMM 生成的 PTODSL 集成 fixture 也有价值。

## 关联项

- #1119（已合入）：physical-section boundary 校验及 lexical section rebinding
- #1095：最初的 physical-section Python 可变变量 / SSA 泄漏问题

## #1165 [Pass Bug] v0.55 emits invalid static-to-dynamic GlobalTensor cast for MGATHER/MSCATTER

- State: closed
- URL: https://github.com/hw-native-sys/PTOAS/issues/1165
- Created: 2026-08-06T04:46:03Z
- Updated: 2026-08-10T03:34:33Z
- Closed: 2026-08-10T03:34:33Z

### Body

### Pass / pipeline name

PTO-to-EmitC lowering (`lib/PTO/Transforms/PTOToEmitC.cpp`)

### Command line

```bash
ptoas-0.55 kernel.pto -o /tmp/mgather-row-055.cpp --enable-insert-sync --pto-level=level3

# Comparison: the same input succeeds with v0.54.
ptoas-0.54 kernel.pto -o /tmp/mgather-row-054.cpp --enable-insert-sync --pto-level=level3
```

### Before IR (input)

```mlir
module attributes {pto.target_arch = "a2a3"} {
  func.func @kernel(%arg0: !pto.ptr<f32>, %arg1: !pto.ptr<i32>, %arg2: !pto.ptr<f32>) attributes {pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<vector>} {
    %c0_i64 = arith.constant 0 : i64
    %c64_i64 = arith.constant 64 : i64
    %c64_index = arith.constant 64 : index
    %c32_index = arith.constant 32 : index
    %c1_index = arith.constant 1 : index
    %c16_index = arith.constant 16 : index
    %c0_index = arith.constant 0 : index
    %mem_view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg0, shape = [%c64_index, %c32_index], strides = [%c32_index, %c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>} : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32>
    %idx_view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg1, shape = [%c1_index, %c16_index], strides = [%c16_index, %c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>} : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xi32>
    %out_view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg2, shape = [%c16_index, %c32_index], strides = [%c32_index, %c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>} : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32>
    %idx_tile = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c0_i64 valid_row = %c1_index valid_col = %c16_index : !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, dtype=i32, rows=1, cols=16, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>
    %idx_part = pto.partition_view %idx_view, offsets = [%c0_index, %c0_index], sizes = [%c1_index, %c16_index] : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xi32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x16xi32>
    pto.tload ins(%idx_part : !pto.partition_tensor_view<1x16xi32>) outs(%idx_tile : !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, dtype=i32, rows=1, cols=16, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>)
    %result = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c64_i64 valid_row = %c16_index valid_col = %c32_index : !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, dtype=f32, rows=16, cols=32, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>
    %mem_part = pto.partition_view %mem_view, offsets = [%c0_index, %c0_index], sizes = [%c64_index, %c32_index] : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<64x32xf32>
    pto.mgather ins(%mem_part, %idx_tile : !pto.partition_tensor_view<64x32xf32>, !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, dtype=i32, rows=1, cols=16, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>) outs(%result : !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, dtype=f32, rows=16, cols=32, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>) {coalesce = #pto<coalesce row>}
    %out_part = pto.partition_view %out_view, offsets = [%c0_index, %c0_index], sizes = [%c16_index, %c32_index] : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<16x32xf32>
    pto.tstore ins(%result : !pto.tile_buf<loc=vec, dtype=f32, rows=16, cols=32, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>) outs(%out_part : !pto.partition_tensor_view<16x32xf32>)
    return
  }
}
```

The same invalid cast is also emitted from PTOAS's own `test/lit/pto/mgather_mscatter_base_a3_emitc.pto`, for both `MGATHER` and `MSCATTER`.

### Expected behavior / expected IR (after)

PTOAS should emit C++ that compiles. A statically-strided `GlobalTensor` produced for the partition view should either be passed directly to `MGATHER`/`MSCATTER`, or be reconstructed into the expected dynamic-stride type using a supported conversion.

v0.54 emits the concrete `GlobalTensor`, converts it to the raw GM pointer expected by the old `MGATHER` path, and the generated C++ compiles.

### Actual IR or error

v0.55 materializes a concrete static-stride `GlobalTensor`, then emits a C-style cast to an otherwise identical `GlobalTensor` whose stride template parameters are all dynamic:

```cpp
GlobalTensor<float,
             pto::Shape<1, 1, 1, 64, 32>,
             pto::Stride<2048, 2048, 2048, 32, 1>,
             pto::Layout::ND> v18 = /* partition view */;

GlobalTensor<float,
             pto::Shape<1, 1, 1, 64, 32>,
             pto::Stride<-1, -1, -1, -1, -1>,
             pto::Layout::ND> v19 =
    (GlobalTensor<float,
                  pto::Shape<1, 1, 1, 64, 32>,
                  pto::Stride<-1, -1, -1, -1, -1>,
                  pto::Layout::ND>)v18;

MGATHER<pto::Coalesce::Row>(dst, v19, idx);
```

`GlobalTensor` has no converting constructor between those template instantiations, so the generated C++ fails with:

```text
error: no matching conversion for C-style cast from
  'GlobalTensor<..., Stride<2048, 2048, 2048, 32, 1>, ...>' to
  'GlobalTensor<..., Stride<-1, -1, -1, -1, -1>, ...>'
```

### Git commit

`3c4c9f7db1328f5bca9b7b353733471ce3c68097` (tag `v0.55`)

### Target Ascend arch (if relevant)

a3

### PTOAS build level (if relevant)

level3

### Additional context

This is a v0.55 regression: the same `.pto` does not emit this cast with v0.54.

The lowering mismatch appears to be:

1. `PTOToEmitCTypeConverter` converts `TensorViewType` / `PartitionTensorViewType` to `GlobalTensor` with all dynamic stride template parameters.
2. `PTOPartitionViewStaticToEmitC` materializes a `GlobalTensor` with concrete static strides.
3. Dialect conversion inserts an `unrealized_conversion_cast` between those two `GlobalTensor` types.
4. The cleanup lowers that cast to `emitc.cast`, producing the unsupported C-style C++ cast above.

The relevant v0.55 changes include:

- `61ed74923da0085b686772d958e9e3b952cd4000` — Keep MGather and MScatter tile-native
- `83901f6729386f0e1489f77abd5898de44afb48b` — Support tensor views directly in backends
- `8d1d8b5d79379e2cc69067b9d8756c6e1144d8da` — Remove memref entry points from PTO address views

Impact: after pinning PyPTO to PTOAS v0.55 in [pypto#2291](https://github.com/hw-native-sys/pypto/pull/2291), all 55 `mgather` system-test variants fail while compiling the generated C++. The upstream lit test currently checks that `MGATHER`/`MSCATTER` text is emitted, but does not compile the generated C++, so it misses this regression.

Acceptance criteria:

- No static-stride to dynamic-stride `GlobalTensor` C-style cast is emitted for `MGATHER` or `MSCATTER`.
- Generated C++ for the minimal reproducer compiles.
- Add a regression test that compiles the EmitC/C++ result for both `MGATHER` and `MSCATTER`, rather than only FileChecking the intrinsic names.
